samples.src: Tattaunawa da kammalawa
samples.ref: Discussion and conclusion
samples.hyp: : An gudanar da binciken a cikin asibitai uku a jihar Kano. An sami isasshen bayanai daga masu amfani da wayar salula. Bayanai an rarraka su ta hanyar amfani da wayar salula, shekaru, da kuma jima'i. An yi amfani da ƙididdiga don ƙididdige dangantaka tsakanin amfani da wayar salula da damar kamuwa da cuta. Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa akwai dangantaka mai kyau tsakanin amfani da wayar salula da damar kamuwa da cuta. Wannan na nufin cewa, yawan amfani da wayar salula na iya haifar da haɗarin kamuwa da cuta.

samples.src: Samfurinmu yana hasashen cewa keɓance aiki na kamuwar COVID-19, gami da marasa alamar cutar, ta hanyar gwajin bargo za a iya amfani da shi a zaman yiwuwar ma'auni don sarrafa yaɗuwar SARS-Cov-2 a Lusaka, Zambiya, amma zai zo da tsada.
samples.ref: Our model predicts that active isolation of COVID-19 cases, including asymptomatic individuals, through blanket testing can be used as a possible measure for the control of the SARS-Cov-2 transmission in Lusaka, Zambia, but it would come at a high cost.
samples.hyp: Haka kuma, mun gano cewa aji na mutane da suka yi cutar COVID-19, da kuma waɗanda ba su yi cutar ba, sun bambanta a cikin ƙayayyakin da suke da su.

samples.src: Gwajin taro a manyan birane kamar Lusaka na iya iyakance yaɗuwar COVID-19, amma tana amfani?
samples.ref: Mass testing in big cities like Lusaka may limit COVID-19 spread, but is it practical?
samples.hyp: A cikin wani bincike, masana sun yi amfani da bayanan wayar da za su, da kuma bayanan da aka samu daga hanyoyin sadarwa, don tantance yadda gwaje-gwajen taro ke shafar yaduwar cutar. Sun gano cewa, a wasu lokuta, gwajin taro na iya rage yaduwar cutar, amma a wasu lokuta, na iya haifar da yaduwar cutar. Masana sun ce, sakamakon ya dogara ne akan yawan mutane da ke yin gwajin taro, da kuma yawan lokaci da suke yin gwajin taro. Suna ƙara cewa, ya zama dole a yi gwajin taro a wurare da yawan mutane ke zuwa, kamar yadda wuraren shakatawa, da kuma kantin sayayya.

samples.src: A cikin shekarar 2020, samfuran kwamfuta sun yi hasashen cewa COVID-19 ya bazu a cikin manyan biranen za a iya sarrafa shi ta hanyar gwaji da yawa, sannan kuma a ware duk waɗanda suka kamu.
samples.ref: In 2020, computer models predicted that COVID-19 spread in large cities could be better controlled by mass testing, and by then isolating all those who tested positive.
samples.hyp: A cikin shekarar 2021, an gudanar da bincike a cikin biranen da aka ambata, kuma an gano cewa hasashen kwamfuta ya kasance daidai. A cikin shekarar 2022, an gudanar da wani bincike a cikin biranen da aka ambata, kuma an gano cewa hasasannin kwamfuta sun kasance daidai.

samples.src: Duk da haka, masu bincike sun ce wannan hanya na iya zama mai tsada kuma ba ta da amfani.

samples.src: A farkon ɓarkewar annobar, yawancin mutanen da suka kamu da COVID-19 ba su nuna alamun cutar ba kuma har yanzu suna yaɗa cutar ga wasu.
samples.ref: Early in the pandemic, many people that were infected with COVID-19 showed no signs of the disease and still spread the disease to others.
samples.hyp: Wannan ya sa ya zama wani abu mai wuya a sarrafa yaduwar cutar. Saboda haka, an ƙara ƙwaƙwalwar ƙwayar cuta (mRNA) don hana kamuwa da cutar. Kodayake, ba a san yadda wannan maganin ke aiki ba, an gano cewa yana taimakawa wajen hana kamuwa da cutar. An gudanar da bincike da yawa don tantance amsar mutane ga maganin, kuma an gano cewa yawancin mutane sun yi amfani da shi ba tare da wata matsala ba. samples.ref: Some studies suggested that 50% to 80% of people with COVID-19 didn’t have symptoms (asymptomatic) and may have been responsible for 40% to 70% of new infections.

An yi amfani da kayan aiki na PCR don ƙididdige bambance-bambancen halitta da muhalli a cikin ƙwayoyin gado. samples.ref: African populations are vastly underrepresented in genetic studies but have the most genetic variation and face wide-ranging environmental exposures globally.

samples.hyp: Saboda haka, an gudanar da bincike don tantance ko yaya cutar ta shiga jikin mutane da ke da bambanci a halin da ake gani. An gano cewa, a cikin mutanen da aka bincaka, mutanen da ke da bambanci a halin da ake gani sun fi yawan kamuwa da cuta fiye da na sauran.

samples.hyp: Kodayake, yana da kyau a lura cewa wannan ba izuwa ba ne, kuma ƙwayoyin gado na mutanen Afirka da na mutanen Asiya suma za su iya bayyana a cikin rumbun bayanai.  Hakanan, yana da kyau a lura cewa ƙwayoyin gado na mutanen da aka haifa a Turai, amma da asalin Afirka, suma za su iya bayyana a cikin rumbun bayanai.

samples.src: Taswirar rumbun bayanan GWAS tana nufin "Geneme-Wide Association Studies", kuma masana kimiyya suna amfani da shi don neman halaye da cututtuka dangane da ƙwayoyin gado.
samples.ref: The GWAS database stands for “Genome-Wide Association Studies”, and scientists use it to look for traits and diseases based on genes.
samples.hyp: Taswirar rumbun bayanan GWAS ta hanyar amfani da bayanan da aka samu daga gwaje-gwaje, tana taimakawa wajen fahimtar yadda halayen mutane da cututtuka ke tasirawa.

samples.src: A gaskiya ma, za su iya amfani da GWAS domin ƙididdige haɗarin ƙwayar gadon mutum domin cuta ko hali.

samples.src: Duk da haka, yawancin bayanan ƙwayoyin halitta a cikin GWAS, sun fito ne daga mutane ‘yan asalin Turai.

samples.hyp: Wannan na iya zama babban batu, saboda bambance-bambancen halittu da ke cikin ƙwayoyin halitta na mutane. Saboda haka, yana da kyau a yi bincike a mutanen da ba ‘yan asalin Turai ba, domin a samu ƙarin fahimta.

samples.src: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su ga yadda lissafin da suke amfani da shi don ƙayyade haɗarin cututtukan ƙwayoyin gado ta amfani da GWAS yana aiki ga mutane ‘yan asalin Afirka.
samples.ref: In this study, researchers wanted to see how well the calculation they use to determine genetic disease risk using GWAS works for people of African ancestry.

samples.src: Ya kamata a gwada matan Namibiya da suke cikin haɗarin kamuwa da cutar kansar mahaifa da wuri da kuma yi musu magani da wuri
samples.ref: Namibian women at risk for cervical cancer should be tested and treated earlier
samples.hyp: . Rigakafin hana haihuwa na iya taimakawa wajen rage yawan kamuwa da cutar kansar mahaifa.

samples.src: Yawancin gwaje-gwaje na iya nuna haɗarin mata don kamuwa da cutar kansar mahaifa, amma binciken yau da kullum a ƙasar Namibiya ba sa amfani da waɗannan gwaje-gwajen.
samples.ref: Many tests can show women’s risk for cervical cancer, but routine check-ups in Namibia don’t always use these tests.
samples.hyp: Saboda haka, muke ƙara da ƙara samun mata da suka kamu da cutar kansar mahaifa, kuma wannan ya haifar da ƙarin matsaloli a cikin al'umma. Domin magance wannan matsala, muna ba da shawarar aiwatar da gwaje-gwajen da za su taimaka wajen gano kansar mahaifa a mataki na farko, domin a iya samar da magani da za su rage yawan kamuwa da cutar.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar yin gwaji akai-akai, don gano alamun gargaɗi tun da farko, yana iya hana mata kamuwa da wannan cuta mai saurin kisa.
samples.ref: Researchers suggest regular testing, to find warning signs earlier, could prevent women from developing this deadly disease.

samples.src: Kansar mahaifa (kansar ƙasan mahaifa) yana haifar da mutuwar mata da yawa a duk duniya.
samples.ref: Cervical cancer (cancer of the lower section of the womb) causes many deaths among women world-wide.
samples.hyp: Binciken da aka yi a Najeriya ya nuna cewa mata da suka yi juna biyu suna da ƙarancin samun damar samun kula da kansar mahaifa. Saboda haka, an gudanar da bincike don tantance abubuwan da ke haifar da rashin samun damar samun kula da kansar mahaifa a cikin mata da suka yi juna biyu a Najeriya. Binciken ya gano cewa akwai abubuwa da yawa da ke haifar da rashin samun damar samun kula da kansar mahaifa a cikin mata da suka yi juna biyu a Najeriya, ciki har da rashin ilimi, talauci, da rashin samun isassun ma'aikata.

samples.src: Ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan da suke haifar da kansar mahaifa shi ne Fafilobairas na Ɗan’adam, ko HPV.
samples.ref: One of the most common causes of cervical cancer is Human Papillomavirus, or HPV.
samples.hyp: HPV wani cuta ce da ke iya kamuwa da ita ta hanyar alaka. Wannan cuta na iya haifar da kwayar cuta a cikin jiki, wanda ke haifar da kansar mahaifa. Akwai nau'o'in HPV da yawa, kuma wasu daga cikinsu sun fi ƙarfin haifar da kansar mahaifa.

samples.src: Cutar HPV ƙwayar cuta ce da take lalata ƙwayoyin mahaifa, ta haifar da raunuka, wanda a ƙarshe za su iya zama kansa.
samples.ref: HPV is a virus that damages the cells of the womb, forming wounds called lesions, which can eventually become cancerous.
samples.hyp: A wasu lokuta, cutar na iya haifar da cutar mahaifa. Bincike da yawa sun nuna cewa cutar HPV na iya haifar da cutar mahaifa, kuma ana iya hana ta ta hanyar rigakafin hana haihuwa.

samples.src: Ko da yake akwai maganin rigakafi domin hana cutar HPV, mata da yawa a cikin ƙasashen Afirka, ciki har da ƙasar Namibiya, ba su da damar yin amfani da shi.
samples.ref: Though a vaccine to prevent HPV exists, many women in African countries, including Namibia, don’t have access to it.

samples.src: Wannan yana nufin bincikar ƙwayar cutar ko raunukan da take haifarwa yana da mahimmanci musamman ga waɗannan mata, domin ita ce hanya mafi dacewa don rigakafin cutar kansa.
samples.ref: This means that checking for the virus or the lesions it causes is especially important for these women, as it is the best way to help prevent cancer.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun ce saboda haka asibitoci suna buƙatar ingantattun jagorori da bayanai game da mafi kyawun gwaje-gwajen da za a yi amfani da su.
samples.ref: The researchers in this study say that hospitals therefore need proper guidelines and information about the best tests to use.
samples.hyp: Bayanai sun nuna cewa akwai bambance-bambance tsakanin yadda asibitoci daban-daban ke aiwatar da gwaje-gwajen, kuma wannan na iya zama sababin bambance-bambancen sakamakon gwaje-gwaje.

samples.src: Sun kuma ƙara da cewa ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya suna buƙatar ƙarin bayani game da yadda abubuwa kamar shekaru ko lafiya ke shafar haɗarin mace na kamuwa da cutar HPV da kuma kansa.
samples.ref: They add that medical staff also need more information about how factors like age or health affect a woman’s risk of getting HPV and cancer.

samples.src: Sun binciki yadda tasirin wasu nau’o’in gwaje-gwaje na yau da kullum (wanda ake kira hanyoyin dubawa) suka kasance domin gano cutar HPV da raunuka.
samples.ref: They investigated how effective some common types of tests (called screening methods) were for finding HPV and lesions.
samples.hyp: An gano cewa hanyoyin dubawa na gani sun fi kyau fiye da hanyoyin da ake amfani da su a gaba, kuma sun fi kyau a gano cutar da ke haifar da raunuka.

samples.src: Suna kuma sha'awar kwatanta hanyoyin tantancewa, misali tattara ƙwayoyin mahaifa don bincikar lalacewa idan aka kwatanta da neman raunuka kawai.
samples.ref: They were also interested in comparing screening methods, for example collecting cells from the womb to check for damage compared to just looking for lesions.

samples.src: Sun kuma so su san ko bambance-bambancen da yake tsakanin mata, kamar shekarunsu, ko kuma suna da wasu cututtuka kamar HIV, sun canza damarsu ta kamuwa da cutar HPV da kuma kansa.
samples.ref: They also wanted to know whether differences between women, like their age, or whether they had other diseases like HIV, changed their chances of getting HPV and cancer.

samples.src: Sanin wannan bayanin zai iya taimaka wa asibitoci da ƙananan asibitoci su yi amfani da hanyoyin tantancewa sosai.
samples.ref: Knowing this information could help hospitals and clinics use screening methods more effectively.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun duba bayanan marasa lafiya na mata guda 214 da aka yi musu gwajin cutar HPV, raunuka, da kansar mahaifa a wani asibiti a Windhoek, ƙasar Namibiya.
samples.ref: The researchers looked at patient records for 214 women who had been screened and treated for HPV, lesions, and cervical cancer at a hospital in Windhoek, Namibia.
samples.hyp: Sun gano cewa kashi 38.3% na mata da suka yi gwajin sun fi yawan kamuwa da cutar HPV.

samples.src: Sun mai da hankali musamman kan kansar mahaifa a farkon matakin, wanda shi ne lokacin da za a iya magance cutar cikin sauƙi da kuma inganci.
samples.ref: They focused specifically on early-stage cervical cancer, which is when the disease can be treated more easily and effectively.
samples.hyp: Binciken ya gano cewa, a cikin mata 1,000, kusan mata 2 sun sami kansar mahaifa a shekarar 1990, kuma wannan adadi ya tashi zuwa kusan mata 3 a shekarar 2020.  Wannan ya nuna karuwar yawan kamuwa da cutar, wanda ke da alaƙa da canjin yanayi da kuma ƙarin yawan yara.

samples.src: Sun kuma tattara bayanai game da shekarun kowace mace, da kuma lafiyarta gabaɗaya.
samples.ref: They also collected information about each woman’s age, and her general health.

samples.src: Ta hanyar nazarin waɗannan bayanan, sun gano cewa fasahohin tantancewa daban-daban sukan bai wa ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya bayanai daban-daban, kuma suna iya zama da amfani kafin ko bayan HPV ta haɓaka zuwa kansa.
samples.ref: By reviewing these records, they found that different screening techniques often gave medical staff different information, and that they might be more useful before or after HPV had developed into cancer.

samples.src: Alal misali, ana samun kansa ta hanyar tattarawa da bincikar ƙwayoyin mahaifa.
samples.ref: Cancer, for example, was often found by collecting and examining womb cells.
samples.hyp: A cikin wannan bincike, mun yi amfani da hanyoyin ƙididdiga don ƙididdige yawan ƙwayoyin mahaifa a cikin ƙwayar jini ta mutane.  Mun kuma yi amfani da hanyoyin bincike don tantance ƙwayoyin mahaifa.

samples.src: Ana iya samun raunuka, duk da haka, sau da yawa kawai tare da dubawa na gani, ta amfani da wata dabara da ake kira “duban gani da sinadarin ruwan kal” (VIA).
samples.ref: Lesions, however, could often be found just with a visual inspection, using a technique called “visual inspection with acetic acid” (VIA).
samples.hyp: VIA yana amfani da sinadarin ruwan kal mai ƙarfi don ba da haske a cikin rauni, wanda ke taimakawa wajen gano ƙwayoyin cuta masu yawa.

samples.src: Amfanin wannan dabarar ita ce ta ba wa likitoci damar gano raunuka cikin sauri da kuma arha.
samples.ref: The advantage of this technique is that it allows doctors to find lesions quickly and cheaply.
samples.hyp: Ta hanyar amfani da wannan hanya, likitoci za su iya tantance ko wata cuta ta haifar da rauni, kuma su gano ko rauni ya warke ko ya ci tashi. Hakanan, wannan dabarar na iya taimakawa wajen ƙididdige yawan ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin rauni, wanda zai iya taimakawa wajen zaɓar maganin da ya fi dacewa.

samples.src: Wannan saboda yana amfani da kayan aikin likita na yau da kullun da aka riga aka yi amfani da su domin gwaje-gwajen lafiyar mata, kamar na’urar buɗe farji (kayan ƙarfe da ake amfani da shi domin duba cikin farji).
samples.ref: This is because it uses basic medical equipment already used for women’s gynaecological examinations, like a speculum (a metal instrument used to look inside the vagina).
samples.hyp: Ana iya amfani da wannan kayan aikin don ɗaukar hotunan gaba ɗaya na cikin farji, wanda ke ba da damar gano mummunan ƙwayar cuta da kuma ƙwayar cuta.  Hakanan, ana iya amfani da shi don tantance ƙwayar cuta, kuma ana iya amfani da shi don tantance mummunan ƙwayar cuta.

samples.src: Haka nan kuma sun gano cewa haɗa hanyoyin daban-daban sau da yawa yana bai wa likitoci ƙarin bayanai game da haɗarin da mace ke da shi na kamuwa da cutar kansa, musamman ma ta duba da yawa.
samples.ref: They also found that combining different methods often gave doctors more information about a woman’s risk for getting cancer, especially over multiple check-ups.

samples.src: Bugu da ƙari, masu binciken sun gano cewa tsofaffin mata, musamman masu ɗauke da cutar HIV, sun fi kamuwa da cutar kansa, don haka, a lokuta da dama yin gwajinsu yana iya zama muhimmi.
samples.ref: In addition, the researchers found that older women, especially those with HIV, were more likely to be diagnosed with cancer, so screening them often could be especially important.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun ƙara da cewa kaɗan ne daga cikin matan da aka yi wa gwajin cutar HPV (kafin neman raunuka) duk da cewa akwai gwaji.
samples.ref: The researchers added that very few of the women were tested for HPV (before looking for lesions) even though a test exists.

samples.src: Yin hakan yana iya zama muhimmiyar hanyar gano cutar ko da wuri.
samples.ref: Doing so could be an important way of finding the disease even sooner.
samples.hyp: Haka kuma, yana da kyau a yi gwajin da za a iya gano cutar da sauri, domin a samu damar yin magani da wuri.

samples.src: Gabaɗaya, sun ce sakamakonsu ya nuna cewa akwai buƙatar tsarin kiwon lafiya a Namibiya domin tsara dabarun rigakafin cutar HPV da cutar kansar mahaifa cikin tunani, ta yin amfani da hanyoyin gwaji masu arha da kuma inganci domin gano waɗannan cututtuka da wuri.
samples.ref: Overall, they said their results showed there was a need for the healthcare system in Namibia to plan HPV and cervical cancer prevention strategies more thoughtfully, using cheap, effective testing methods to find these diseases as early as possible.

samples.src: Binciken ya kasance na haɗin gwiwa ne tsakanin masana kimiyya daga ƙasashen Namibiya da kuma Afirka ta Kudu.
samples.ref: The study was a collaboration between scientists from Namibia and South Africa.
samples.hyp: An yi amfani da kayan aiki na zamani da kuma ƙididdiga don tantance yawan ƙwayoyin cuta da kuma yadda suke tasowa a cikin jama'a. Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa akwai bambance-bambance tsakanin yawan ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin ƙasashe daban-daban, kuma wannan ya iya zama sakamakon yanayin yanayi, al'adu, da kuma yanayin zamantakewa. Haka kuma, an gano cewa wasu nau'o'in ƙwayoyin cuta sun fi yawa a wasu ƙasashe fiye da wasu, kuma wannan na iya zama sakamakon yadda mutane ke shakatawa da kuma yadda suke hulɗa juna.

samples.src: Amfanin jiyya a cikin kamuwa da HBV/HIV idan aka kwatanta da HBV kaɗai cikin marasa lafiya na Afirka ta Kudu
samples.ref: Treatment advantage in HBV/HIV coinfection compared to HBV monoinfection in a South African cohort

samples.src: Ƙaddamar da maƙasudin ƙasa-da-ƙasa don kawar da ciwon hanta na B (HBV), mun tashi don kwatanta ɗaiɗaikun mutane tare da kamuwa HBV da kuma waɗanda suka kamu da cututtuka biyu, wato HBVB/HIV, don kimanta tasirin jiyya da kuma jagoranci ingantawa a cikin kulawar asibiti.
samples.ref: Prompted by international targets for elimination of hepatitis B virus (HBV), we set out to characterise individuals with HBV monoinfection vs. those coinfected with HBV/HIV, to evaluate the impact of therapy and to guide improvements in clinical care.

samples.src: Muna ba da rahoton bayanan lura daga ƙungiyar nazari mai zurfi ta ainihi ta duniya na manya 115 masu fama da cutar hanta ta B mai tsanani (CHB), a wani asibitin jami’a a Cape Town, ta ƙasar Afirka ta Kudu.
samples.ref: We report observational data from a real world cross-sectional cohort of 115 adults with chronic hepatitis B infection (CHB), at a university hospital in Cape Town, South Africa.
samples.hyp: An yi amfani da takardun lafiya na marasa lafiya don tattara bayanai game da halayen lafiyar su, da kuma ƙididdigar ƙwayoyin jini. An yi gwajin ƙwayoyin jini don gano cutar hepatitis B (HBV).

samples.src: An samu kasancewar wata ƙwayar cutar da ƙwayar cutar HIV a cikin batutuwa 39 (34%).
samples.ref: HIV coinfection was present in 39 (34%) subjects.
samples.hyp: A cikin batutuwa ɗaya, an gano wata ƙwayar cuta mai cutar da ƙwayar cutar HIV, wacce ta haɗu da wata ƙwayar cuta mai cutar da ƙwayar cutar HIV. A cikin batutuwa 12, an gano wata ƙwayar cuta mai cutar da ƙwayar cutar HIV, wacce ba ta haɗu da wata ƙwayar cuta mai cutar da ƙwayar cutar HIV.

samples.src: Mun rubuta bayanan alƙaluman nazari mai zurfi da bayanan asibiti da kuma ɗakin gwaje-gwaje.
samples.ref: We recorded cross-sectional demographic, clinical and laboratory data.
samples.hyp: Bayan haka, mun yi aiyuka na ƙididdiga da kuma ƙididdige daidai da ƙa'idodi.

samples.src: Idan aka kwatanta da waɗanda suke ɗauke da wata ƙwayar cutar da ƙwayar cutar HIV, manya masu kamuwa da cutar Ciwon Hanta na B ba su da yiwuwar zama HBeAg-tabbatacce (p=0.01), da wuya a yi ƙima tare da elastography (p <0.0001), kuma da wuya a kasance a kan maganin rigakafin ƙwayar cutar (p <0.0001) ); sun kasance mafi kusantar samun ganewar Ciwon Hanta na B viraemia (p=0.04), kuma mafi kusantar samun siffofin cutar hanta ciki har da matsakaici / matsananciyar thrombocytopaenia (p=0.007), haɓakar bilirubin (p=0.004), da ƙimar APRI mai girma (p=0.02).
samples.ref: Compared to those with HIV coinfection, HBV monoinfected adults were less likely to be HBeAg-positive (p=0.01), less likely to have had assessment with elastography (p<0.0001), and less likely to be on antiviral treatment (p<0.0001); they were more likely to have detectable HBV viraemia (p=0.04), and more likely to have features of liver disease including moderate/severe thrombocytopaenia (p=0.007), elevated bilirubin (p=0.004), and elevated APRI score (p=0.02).

samples.src: Abubuwa uku na nau’in kansar hanta duk suna tasowa ne a yayin da ake da HBV kaɗai.
samples.ref: Three cases of hepatocellular carcinoma all arose in HBV monoinfection.
samples.hyp: A cikin ƙungiyar, an gano cewa mutanen da ke da HBV kaɗan sun fi yawan kamuwa da kansar hanta fiye da waɗanda ba su da HBV. Wannan ya nuna cewa HBV na iya zama babban abin da ke haifar da kansar hanta. Haka kuma, an gano cewa mutanen da ke da HBV da kuma kansar hanta sun fi yawan kamuwa da cutar da ke haifar da hepatitis B fiye da waɗanda ke da kansar hanta ɗaya. Wannan ya nuni da cewa HBV na iya zama babban abin da ke haifar da kamuwa da cutar hepatitis B.

samples.src: Bayananmu sun nuna cewa mutanen da suke da HBV kaɗai suna iya zama cikin ƙwaruwa idan aka kwatanta da waɗanda suke da ƙwayar cutar HIV, suna nuna yiwuwar rashin daidaito na tsari a cikin turawa da saka-idanu da kuma magani.
samples.ref: Our data demonstrate that individuals with HBV monoinfection may be disadvantaged compared to those with HIV coinfection, highlighting potential systematic inequities in referral, monitoring and treatment.
samples.hyp: Saboda haka, binciken da ake yi a kan mutanen da ke da HBV da HIV ya zama wajibi.

samples.src: Masu binciken suna bayar da jagororin inganta maganin ciwon hanta na B
samples.ref: Researchers give guidelines to improve hepatitis B treatment
samples.hyp: iyu, wanda ya haɗa da amfani da magani, da kuma ƙara ƙarfin jiki.

samples.src: A cikin binciken da aka yi kwanan nan, masu bincike sun sami damar bayyana yadda kamuwa da ciwon hanta na B (HBV) da cutar Ƙanjamau (HIV) suna iya bayar da fa’idar jiyya a kan kamuwa da cuta tare da HBV kaɗai.
samples.ref: In a recent study, researchers were able to highlight how being infected with both hepatitis B (HBV) and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) may offer a treatment advantage over infection with only HBV.
samples.hyp: Sun gano cewa, a cikin mutanen da suka kamu da HBV da HIV, jiyya da aka gina akan maganin antiretroviral (ART) na iya rage yawan ƙwayoyin cutar HBV a jini. Wannan na iya zama saboda cewa maganin ART yana taimakawa wajen ƙara ƙarfin tsarin garkuwa, wanda ke taimakawa jiki ya yi yaƙi da kowanne nau'in cuta. Duk da haka, yana da mahimmanci a lura cewa jiyya da ART ba ta cika cutar HBV ba, kuma mutanen da ke samun fa'ida daga jiyya irin wannan suna buƙatar ci gaba da samun magani don hana sake kamuwa da cuta.

samples.src: A kudancin Afirka, kamuwa da cuta mai tsanani ta HBV da kuma HIV babbar matsala ce.
samples.ref: In southern Africa, chronic infection with both HBV and HIV is a major problem.
samples.hyp: Saboda haka, binciken da ke da nufin tantance ko akwai alaka tsakanin HBV da HIV ya zama abu na daɗewa. A wannan binciken, mun tantance yawan mutanen da suka kamu da HBV da HIV a cikin ƙungiyar mutane da aka bincaka. Mun kuma tantance ko akwai bambance-bambance a tsakanin mutanen da suka kamu da HBV da HIV da wadanda ba su kamu da kowane cuta ba. Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa akwai bambance-bambance mai kyau tsakanin mutanen da suka kamu da HBV da HIV da wadanda ba su kamu da kowane cuta ba. Wannan ya nuna cewa akwai alaka tsakanin HBV da HIV.

samples.src: Likitoci suna buƙatar fahimtar yadda waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta da magungunan da ake amfani da su don magance su suke cuɗar juna, ta yadda za su fi dacewa da ganewar asali da kuma kula da marasa lafiya.
samples.ref: Doctors need to understand how these viruses and the medications used to treat them interact with one another, so that they can better diagnose and care for patients.
samples.hyp: Hakanan, yana da mahimmanci a gudanar bincike don tantance ko waɗannan magunguna suna da amfani ga mutanen Afirka, kuma idan ba haka ba, ya zama dole a gano magunguna da suka dace da su.

samples.src: Masu bincike sun so kwatanta tasirin jiyya ga marasa lafiya waɗanda suke da HBV kaɗai, tare da marasa lafiya waɗanda suke da HBV da kuma HIV.
samples.ref: Researchers wanted to compare the effects of therapy on patients who had HBV only, with patients who had both HBV and HIV.
samples.hyp: An rarraba marasa lafiya zuwa cikin rukuni biyu: rukuni na ɗaya, marasa lafiya waɗanda suke da HBV kaɗai; da kuma rukuni na biyu, marasa lafiya waɗanda suke da HBV da kuma HIV. An gudanar da gwajin a asibiti ɗaya a Najeriya. An sami bambance-bambance tsakanin rukuni biyu a cikin adadin platelets, albumin, da kuma adadin ƙwayoyin jini.

samples.src: Don wannan binciken, masu binciken sun ɗauki majinyata 115 manya masu fama da ciwon hanta na B mai tsanani (CHB).
samples.ref: For this study the researchers recruited 115 adult patients with chronic hepatitis B infection (CHB).
samples.hyp: An rarraba majinyata zuwa biyu: 60 maza da 55 mata. An gudanar da gwaje-gwaje daban-daban a cikin wannan binciken, gami da gwajen jinin, gwajen ƙwaya, da kuma gwajen ƙamshin. An yi amfani da bayanai daga waɗannan gwaje-gwaje don ƙididdige yanayin majinyata da kuma yadda suke amsa ga magani.

samples.src: Wasu marasa lafiya (39) sun kamu da cutar HIV sauran kuma sun kamu da cutar HBV kaɗai.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun duba launin fata da shekaru da kuma jinsi, kuma sun gudanar da gwaje-gwajen asibiti da na ɗakin gwaje-gwaje daban-daban.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun gano cewa marasa lafiya waɗanda suke da HBV kaɗai ba su da yiwuwar kasancewa a kan kowane nau’i na maganin rigakafi, suna nuna alamun cututtukan hanta (tunda HBV ƙwayar cuta ce wacce za ta iya haifar da cutar hanta mai tsanani).
samples.ref: They found that patients who only had HBV were less likely to be on any form of antiviral treatment, showing natural symptoms of liver disease (since HBV is a virus that may cause severe liver disease).

samples.ref: The researchers were able to show that individuals with HBV only were at a disadvantage when compared to those with both HIV and HBV, as patients infected with both viruses were likely to be on antiviral HIV treatment, which also offers some benefit in combating HBV infection.

samples.src: Sakamako daga wannan binciken yana nuna yiwuwar tasirin bambance-bambance tsakanin turawa da saka-idanu da zaɓuɓɓukan magani na Ciwon Hanta na B idan aka kwatanta da ƙwayar cutar HIV da kuma HBV wanda yake fifita waɗanda suka kamu da cutar HIV da kuma HBV.
samples.ref: The results from this study highlight the potential impact of differences between referral, monitoring and treatment options for HBV when compared to HIV and HBV coinfection, which favours those infected with both HIV and HBV.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun nuna cewa dole ne mu inganta da samar da mafi aminci da adalci ga majinyata da suka kamu da HBV kaɗai.
samples.ref: The researchers highlighted that we must improve and provide a safer and fairer service for patients infected with HBV only.

samples.src: Iyakancewa ɗaya na wannan binciken ita ce adadin jama'a kaɗan wanda ya keɓanta ga ƙasa ɗaya kawai da kuma tsarin asibitocinsu.

An yi amfani da bayanai da aka samu don ƙirƙirar ƙa'idar da ke da alaƙa da yadda cutar ta taso da yadda ta haifar da cuta a cikin mutane.

samples.hyp: Ta hanyar amfani da hanyoyin da suka dace, masu bincike sun ƙididdige yawan mutane da suka kamu da cutar da suka fi yawa a Afirka ta Kudu, da kuma yadda cutar ke yaɗuwa a cikin sauri a cikin yankin.

samples.src: Baya ga wannan, binciken na iya taimakawa wajen samar da ingantattun tsare-tsaren jiyya ga waɗanda suke fama da HBV, HIV ko kuma duka biyun.
samples.ref: Additionally, the study may help to develop better treatment plans for those suffering with either HBV, HIV or both.
samples.hyp: Hakanan, yana da kyau a yi bincike game da yadda cutar ta shiga jiki, yadda ta haifar da cuta, da kuma yadda za a hana ta.

samples.src: Tantance Tasirin Taɓarɓarewar Tsaro a Harkokin Kasuwancin Mata A Ƙaramar Hukumar SHIRORO ta Jihar Neja.
samples.ref: Assessment of the Impact of Insecurity on Women's Entrepreneurial Activities in SHIRORO Local Government Area of Niger State
samples.hyp: Aikin bincike na gudanar da bincike game da tasirin taɓarɓarewar tsaro a harkokin kasuwancin mata a ƙaramar hukumar Shiroro ta jihar Neja. An yi amfani da ƙididdigar bayanan da aka gudanar a cikin ƙaramar hukumar, kuma an yi amfani da takardun da aka samu da kuma tattaunawa da wasu mutane. Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa taɓarɓarewar tsaro na da tasiri mai yawa a harkokin kasuwancin mata a ƙaramar hukumar. Taɓarɓarewar ta haifar da wani mummunan tasiri a harkokin kasuwancin mata, wanda ya haifar da raguwar kaso da kuma lalacewar abubuwa.

samples.src: Wannan binciken ya yi nazari ne a kan illar rashin tsaro ga harkokin kasuwanci da mata suke yi a Ƙaramar Hukumar Shiroro ta Jihar Neja, inda ya mayar da hankali, musamman a kan batutuwan da suka shafi dogaro da kuɗaɗen mata, da irin harkokin kasuwanci da ya zama ruwan dare a tsakaninsu da kuma girman tasirin rashin tsaro a kan harkokin kasuwancinsu.
samples.ref: This study examined the impact of insecurity on the entrepreneurial activities of women in Shiroro Local Government Area of Niger State, focusing specifically on issues about women’s financial dependence, the kind of entrepreneurial activities common among them and the dimension of the impact of insecurity on their entrepreneurial endeavours.

samples.src: An yi nazarin samfurin mata guda 377, wanda ya kai ga gano cewa mata a Shiroro sun kasance masu sana'o’i ne sosai tare da samun ‘yancin kai na kuɗi, galibi suna shiga SMEs.
samples.ref: A sample of 377 women was surveyed, leading to the findings that women in Shiroro are highly entrepreneurial with high level of financial independence, engaging mostly in SMEs.
samples.hyp: Duk da haka, an gano cewa akwai bambance-bambance tsakanin matan da ke cikin birni da na ƙauye, tare da matan da ke cikin birni da ke da damar samun ilimi da ayyuka fiye da matan ƙauye.

samples.src: Har ila yau binciken ya gano cewa, a yayin da rashin tsaro yake da illa ga harkokin kasuwanci na mata ta hanyar asara ko raguwar jari a tsakanin sauran abubuwa, adadin mata masu sana’ar kasuwanci bai samu wani gagarumin koma baya ba.
samples.ref: The study also found that while insecurity has an adverse effect on women’s entrepreneurial activities in the form of loss of or decline of capital among other things, the number of women entrepreneurs has not experienced a significant decline.
samples.hyp: Adadin mata masu sana'ar kasuwanci ya kasance kusan iri ɗaya a cikin shekarun da aka bincaka.

samples.src: Binciken ya bayar da shawarar cewa ya kamata a samar da tsare-tsare masu ɗorewa domin inganta hanyoyin samun damar mata da kuma amfani da ayyukan kuɗi da kuma samar da ƙungiyoyin ‘yan sandan al’umma da kuma ƙarfafa su domin yaƙi da rashin tsaro a yankin binciken.
samples.ref: The study recommended that sustainable programmes to improve women’s access to and use of financial services should be created and community policing organisations should also be created and strengthened to combat insecurity in the study area.
samples.hyp: Haka kuma, ya bayyana cewa ya zama dole a ƙara daidaito a cikin ayyukan da ke da alhakin samar da ayyukan yi da kuma samar da kuɗi, domin rage yawan rashin da mata ke fuskanta.

samples.src: Mata ‘yan kasuwa a Neja suna buƙatar ƙarin tsaro
samples.ref: Business women in Niger need more security
samples.hyp: , saboda yawan laifayen da suke fuskanta.  Hukumar kula da kasuwanni ta jima da yiwa mata ‘yan kasuwanni wannan sabis, amma har yanzu ba su da isasshen adadi.  A wasu kasuwanni, mata ‘yan kasuwa suna haɗa kai don samar da tsaro na kansu, amma wannan ba zai iya magance matsala ba.  Hukuma ta kamata ta dauki mataki don kare mata ‘yan kasuwanni daga laifayen da suke fuskanta.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun gano cewa mata 'yan kasuwa a Neja sun kasance masu sana'o’i ne sosai tare da samun ‘yancin kai na kuɗi, amma batun tsaro daga masu aikata laifuka matsala ce.
samples.ref: Researchers found that businesswomen in Niger are highly entrepreneurial and financially independent, but safety from criminals is an issue.
samples.hyp: Sannan, an gano cewa akwai bambance-bambancen tsayin dangi, kuma wannan ya shafi yadda suke gudanar da ayyukan su.  A ƙarshe, binciken ya nuna cewa akwai alaka mai ƙarfi tsakanin ilimi da yawan kuɗin da mata ke samu.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun so sanin yadda matan da suke gudanar da sana’o’i a Ƙaramar Hukumar Shiroro a Jihar Neja suke cikin aminci da tsaro, da kuma yadda hakan zai iya shafar kasuwancinsu da ‘yancin cin gashin kansu.
samples.ref: Researchers wanted to know how safe and secure women who run businesses in the Shiroro Local Government Area of Niger State are, and how this may impact their businesses and financial independence.
samples.hyp: Binciken ya ƙunshi ɗaukar ra'ayoyi daga mata 200 da ke da shekaru 18 zuwa 35, da kuma tuntuɓe da jami'an gwamnati da ƙungiyoyin al'umma. Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa matan da suke gudanar da sana'o'i suna fuskantar ƙalubalge da dama, kamar rikici, lalacewa, da kuma rashin samun damar shiga cikin ƙungiyoyin da ke kare hakkinsu. Duk da haka, an gano cewa matan da ke cikin wannan ƙaramar hukuma suna da ƙarfin gwiwa da kuma ɗaɗa ra'ayi, kuma suna ɗaukar matakai don inganta yanayinsu.

samples.src: Sun tattauna da mata guda 377 a wannan fanni game da ƙalubalolin da suke fuskanta ta fuskar harkokin kasuwanci da dogaro da kuɗi da kuma rashin tsaro.
samples.ref: They interviewed 377 women in this area about the challenges they face in terms of their entrepreneurial activities, financial dependencies and insecurities.

samples.src: Sun bayyana cewa kashi 43% na matan sun ce ba sa dogara ga maza don neman kuɗi, kuma kashi 32% sun ce suna da wasu mutane da suke dogara da su domin neman kuɗi.
samples.ref: They reported that 43% of the women said they did not depend on men for money, and 32% said they had other people depending on them for money.
samples.hyp: Kashi 25% kuma sun ce suna neman kuɗi ne kawai.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa kashi 85% na matan suna samun kuɗi ne daga sana’o’i daban-daban, kuma kaɗan ne suka ce sun dogara da albashi.
samples.ref: The researchers also found out that 85% of the women were making money from different businesses, and only a few said they depended on salaries.
samples.hyp: Duk da haka, matan da suka dogara da albashi sun fi yawan samun ilimi fiye da matan da suke da sana'o'i. Haka kuma, an gano cewa akwai dangantaka mai kyau tsakanin yawan kuɗin da mata ke samu da kuma ilimin da suka samu.

samples.src: Kusan kashi 56% sun sami kuɗi ta hanyar noma, kuma 79% ta hanyar kasuwanci.
samples.ref: About 56% made money through farming, and 79% through trading.
samples.hyp: Duk da haka, kashi 21% na mutane sun sami kuɗi ne kawai ta hanyar aikin gona, yayin da kashi 11% na mutane sun dogara ne kawai ga kasuwanci. Wannan ya nuna cewa akwai dogaro sosai ga ayyukan noma da kasuwanci a wannan al'umma.

samples.src: Kusan 1 cikin mata 5 suna samun kuɗi ne ta hanyar kitso da ɗinki da saƙa ko kuma yin wanki.
samples.ref: About 1 in 5 women earned money through plaiting hair, sewing, knitting or doing some laundry.
samples.hyp: Kusan 1 cikin 10 na maza suna samun kuɗi ta hanyar aikin gona. Kusan 1 cikin 2 na yara suna yin aiki. A cikin wannan adadi, kusan 1 cikin 4 suna yin aiki a cikin gona.

samples.src: Yawancin matan (91%) sun gaya wa masu binciken cewa tsoron kada ɓarayi da masu aikata laifuka su kai musu hari ya shafi kasuwancinsu.
samples.ref: Most of the women (91%) told the researchers that their businesses were affected by their fear of being attacked by thieves and criminals.
samples.hyp: Duk da haka, kashi 28% na matan sun bayyana cewa rashin samun izinin kasuwanci da kuma tsarin biyan haraji ya shafi kasuwancinsu. Haka kuma, kashi 15% na matan sun bayyana cewa rashin samun isassun kayayyaki da kuma buƙatun kasuwanni ya shafi kasuwancinsu.

samples.src: Sukan yi asarar kuɗi har ma da mazajensu sakamakon waɗannan hare-hare, wani lokaci ma sukan tilasta musu biyan buƙatun ‘ya’yansu su kaɗai.
samples.ref: They lose money and even their husbands to these attacks, sometimes forcing them to provide for their children alone.
samples.hyp: A wasu lokuta, mata suna fuskantar ƙalubale a cikin al'ummomi inda ba su da damar samun kuɗi, wanda ke haifar da ƙalubale a cikin dangalan su.

samples.src: Matan sun kuma ce ba su da isassun ƙwarewa da kuɗin da za su iya faɗaɗa sana’o’insu.
samples.ref: The women also said they did not have enough skills and money to expand their businesses.
samples.hyp: Haka kuma, sun bayyana cewa suna da matsaloli a samun damar kuɗi, da kuma ƙarancin ƙwarewar gudanar da kasuwanni.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun bayyana cewa, duk da waɗannan ƙalubalolin, matan Neja sun ci gaba da samun ci gaba sosai a harkokin kasuwancinsu.
samples.ref: The researchers reported that despite those challenges, Niger women continued to do very well in their businesses.
samples.hyp: Sun gano cewa, matan da ke da damar samun ilimi, da kuma waɗanda ke da isassun kuɗi, sun fi kasancewa cikin ayyukan kasuwanci, kuma sun fi samun nasara a gare su. Haka kuma, sun gano cewa, matan da ke da dangantaka mai ƙarfi da sauran mazaunai, sun fi yiwuwa su sami goyon baya da taimako, wanda ya taimaka musu wajen bunkasar kasuwancin su.

samples.src: Sun ce Shiroro tana da mutane masu ƙabilu da addinai daban-daban, kuma wannan ma yana da kyau ga kasuwanci.
samples.ref: They said Shiroro had people of different tribes and religions, and this was also good for business.

samples.src: Wannan binciken ya ƙalubalanci sakamakon binciken wasu masu bincike da suka bayar da rahoton cewa mata suna da ƙarancin nasara a harkokin kasuwanci saboda kasancewarsu masu kulawa da gida.
samples.ref: This study challenges the findings of other researchers who reported that women have less business success because of being caretakers at home.
samples.hyp: Bincikenmu ya nuna cewa, a zahiri, babu bambanci mai mahimmanci a tsakanin maza da mata a cikin samfurinmu, kuma kowane bambamin da aka gano ya iya faruwa ne sakamakon saɓabbin yanayi, ba bambance-bambancen jima'i ba.  Hakanan, bincikenmu ya bayyana cewa matan da ke da ƙarin alhama a gida sun fi yawan samun nasara a kasuwanni da ake buƙatar ƙwarewar gida.

samples.src: A maimakon haka, waɗannan masu binciken sun ce nasarar da mata 'yan kasuwa suke samu a wannan yanki na Neja ya fi yin tasiri ne sakamakon barazanar hare-haren masu aikata laifuka da kuma ɓarayi.
samples.ref: Instead, these researchers say that the success of business women in this area of Niger is impacted most by the threat of attacks by criminals and thieves.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa duk masu ruwa da tsaki su hallara wuri guda don yaƙar abubuwan da za su iya sa wahalar samun nasara a kasuwanci.
samples.ref: The researchers recommended that all stakeholders should come together and fight against factors that could make it difficult to succeed in business.

samples.src: Alal misali, ya kamata mata a Neja su ƙara samun kuɗaɗe da gonaki da kuma tsaro.
samples.ref: For example, women in Niger should gain more access to funding, farms and safety.
samples.hyp: Haka kuma, ya kamata a ba su damar shiga cikin ayyukan siyasa da kuma shiga cikin ƙungiyoyin zamantakewa.  A ƙarshe, ya kamata a ba su ilimi da horo don su zama masu tasiri a cikin al'ummarsu.

samples.src: Sun kuma bayar da shawarar cewa mata masu sana'a za su iya kafa ƙungiyoyin da za su taimaka musu wajen yaƙar ɓarayi da kuma masu aikata laifuka.
samples.ref: They also suggested that women in business could form groups that would help them fight against thieves and criminals.

samples.src: An alaƙanta Yawan Jinin Haihuwa da Sinadaran Saleniyam da Kofa da kuma Zin a Lokacin Ɗaukar Ciki da kuma Haɗarin Haihuwar Bakwaini: Nazarin Kulawa daga Malawi
samples.ref: Maternal Serum Concentrations of Selenium, Copper and Zinc during Pregnancy are associated with Risk of Spontaneous Preterm Birth: A case-control study from Malawi

samples.src: Haihuwar bakwaini shi ne haihuwa kafin cikar makonni 37.
samples.ref: Preterm birth is delivery before 37 completed weeks.
samples.hyp: Rashin lafiyar da ke biyo bayan haihuwa na iya zama mai ƙarfi kuma yana iya haifar da matsalolin lafiya masu yawa ga yaro. Saboda haka, yana da mahimmanci a kula da mata da ke da haɗarin haihuwa na bakwaini.

samples.src: An gudanar da wani bincike don kimanta alaƙar yawan jinin haihuwa da sinadarin saleniyam da jan ƙarfe da sinadarin zin da kuma haihuwar bakwaini.
samples.ref: A study was conducted to evaluate the association of maternal serum concentrations of selenium, copper, and zinc, and preterm birth.
samples.hyp: An ɗauki ɗidɗin jini daga mata 100 da ke dauke da ciki a wani asibiti a Najeriya. An auna yawan sinadarin saleniyam, jan ƙarfe, da sinadarin zin a cikin dukkanin ɗidɗin jini. An kuma duba mata su don su bayyana ko sun haihu a lokaci ko ba a lokaci. Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa akwai alaƙa mai kyau tsakanin yawan sinadarin saleniyam da haihuwar bakwaini. Wannan yana nufin cewa mata da ke da ƙarancin sinadarin saleniyam a jinsu suna da ƙarancin yuwuwar haihuwa a lokaci. Hakanan, an gano cewa akwai alaƙa tsakanin yawan jan ƙarfe da haihuwar bakwaini, da kuma yawan sinadarin zin da haihuwar bakwaini.

samples.src: Akwai mata 181 a cikin wannan binciken na musamman, 90/181 (49.7%) da 91/181 (50.3%) mata masu juna biyu kafin haihuwa.
samples.ref: There were 181 women in this nested case-control study, 90/181 (49.7%) term and 91/181 (50.3%) preterm pregnant women.
samples.hyp: A cikin mata 90 da suka haihu kafin binciken, 30 (33.3%) sun yi amfani da rigakafin hana haihuwa a wancan lokaci. A cikin mata 91 da ba su haihu ba kafin binciken, 10 (11.0%) sun yi amfani da rigakafin hana haihuwa.

samples.src: Matsakaicin matsakaitan yawan ƙwayar sinadarin saleniyam shi ne 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, jan ƙarfe ya kasance 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L da kuma sinadarin zin ya kasance 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L tare da waiwaye ga darajoji na 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L da kuma 0.59-1.11 mg/L, bi da bi.
samples.ref: The overall mean serum concentration of selenium was 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, copper was 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L and zinc was 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L with reference values of 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L and 0.59-1.11 mg/L, respectively.

samples.src: Sakamakon ya nuna cewa babu ƙaranci na sinadarin saleniyam, da sinadarin zin; da yawan sinadarin jan ƙarfe a juna-biyu.
samples.ref: Results show that there was no deficiency of selenium, and zinc; and high serum concentrations of copper in pregnancy.
samples.hyp: Duk da haka, an gano ƙarancin sinadarin jan ƙarfe a cikin wasu mutane.

samples.src: Haihuwar bakwaini yana da alaƙa da yawaitar adadin ƙwayar jan karfe da sinadarin zin.
samples.ref: Preterm birth was associated with higher maternal serum concentrations of copper and zinc.

samples.src: Sinadarin zin da jan ƙarfe da kuma abubuwan sinadarin saleniyam masu alaƙa da haihuwar bakwaini.
samples.ref: Zinc, copper, and selenium concentrations associated with preterm birth

samples.src: Masu bincike sun gano yawan ma'adanai na sinadiran saleniyam da jan ƙarfe da kuma sinadari zin, a cikin matan da suka haifi bakwaini, amma har yanzu ba su san ko waɗannan abubuwan da ke tattare da su sun fito ne daga abincin da suke ci ba.
samples.ref: Researchers found high concentrations of the micronutrients selenium, copper, and zinc, in women who had preterm births, but they still do not know whether these high concentrations come from the food they eat.

samples.src: Haihuwar bakwaini na faruwa ne lokacin da mace ta haihu kafin ta cika makonni 37 na ciki.
samples.ref: A preterm birth occurs when a woman gives birth before she completes 37 weeks of pregnancy.
samples.hyp: Wannan ya haifar da matsaloli da dama ga yara, kamar su rashin lafiya, lalacewar ci gaba, da kuma haɗarin mutuwa. Haka kuma, yana iya zama mai wahala ga iyalai, tunda yana buƙatar kula da yawa da kuma goyan baya.

samples.src: Haihuwar bakwaini tana da alaƙa da mummunan sakamakon lafiya ga jariri tun daga lahani na haihuwa zuwa mutuwa.
samples.ref: Preterm birth is associated with negative health outcomes for the baby ranging from birth defects to death.

samples.src: Akwai dalilai da yawa na haifar da haihuwar bakwaini, amma ba a san rawar da yawan ma'adanai na abubuwan gina jiki da ake samu a abinci da muhalli suke takawa ba.
samples.ref: There can be many causes to preterm birth, but the role of high concentrations of micronutrients found in food and the environment is relatively unknown.
samples.hyp: Bincikenmu ya yi ƙoƙarin tantance ko akwai alaka tsakanin yawan wasu ma'adanai da haihuwar bakwaini. Mun yi amfani da bayanan da aka samu daga gwaje-gwaje da aka gudanar a cikin shekarar 2018 zuwa 2022, wanda ya haɗa da mata 2,500 da suka haihu. Mun ƙididdige alaka tsakanin yawan ma'adanai kamar iron, zinc, da calcium, da haihuwar bakwaini.

samples.src: Waɗannan abubuwan gina jiki suna da mahimmanci ga ci gaban jariri, amma masu bincike suna so su san abin da zai faru idan akwai su da yawa.
samples.ref: These micronutrients are important for the development of the baby, but researchers want to know what happens when there is too much of them.
samples.hyp: Don haka, sun yi nazarin yadda abubuwan gina jiki ke shafar ci gaban yara. Sun gano cewa yawan abubuwan gina jiki na iya haifar da matsaloli ga yara.

samples.src: Don wannan binciken, masu bincike sun yi niyyar auna adadin sinadarin saleniyam da jan ƙarfe da sinadarin zin a cikin matan da suka haifi bakwaini, sannan kuma don tantance rashin yiwuwar haihuwar bakwaini yana faruwa ne sakamakon yawan adadin kowane nau'in abubuwan gina jiki da aka nazarta.
samples.ref: For this study, researchers aimed to measure the amounts of selenium, copper, and zinc in women who had preterm births, and then to determine the odds that preterm birth is caused by high amounts of each of the micronutrients studied.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun tattara samfurin jini daga mata 181 kai-tsaye bayan sun haihu a asibitoci biyu a Lilongwe, babban birnin Malawi, tsakanin watan Yuni na shekarar 2016 da kuma Maris 2017.
samples.ref: The researchers collected blood samples from 181 women right after they gave birth at two hospitals in Lilongwe, the capital of Malawi, between June 2016 and March 2017.
samples.hyp: An yi gwajin samfurin jini don gano ko akwai ƙwayoyin cutar HIV, da kuma ƙwayoyin cutar ƙwayar cuta.

samples.src: Sun aika da samfuran jinin ne zuwa ɗakin gwaje-gwaje a ƙasar Norway inda suka fitar da ƙwayar jini, nau'in jini mafi kyau, kuma sun auna adadin sinadarin saleniyam da jan ƙarfe da kuma sinadarin zin.
samples.ref: They shipped the blood samples to a laboratory in Norway where they extracted the serum, a purer form of blood, and measured the amounts of selenium, copper and zinc.

samples.src: Kimanin rabin mata 181 da aka gudanar da binciken a kan su sun haifi bakwaini, kuma masu bincike sun gano sinadarin saleniyam da jan ƙarfe da kuma sinadarin zin da yawa.
samples.ref: About half of the 181 women in the study had preterm births, and researchers found very high amounts of selenium, copper and zinc.

samples.src: Daga nan sai suka daidaita lissafinsu don yin la’akari da wasu dalilai da yawa kamar shekaru da lafiya gabaɗaya da tarihin ciki don samun madogara game da zargin illolin da abubuwan gina jiki ke haifarwa na haihuwar bakwaini.
samples.ref: They then adjusted their calculations to account for many other factors such as age, general health, and pregnancy history to tease out the suspected effects of the micronutrients in causing preterm birth.

samples.src: Sun yi ittifakin cewa yawan sinadarin saleniyam da jan ƙarfe ba sa taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen haifar da haihuwar bakwaini, amma yawan sinadarin zin na ƙara haɗarin haihuwar bakwaini da sama da sau 6.
samples.ref: They concluded that large amounts of selenium and copper did not play a significant role in causing preterm birth, but that high amounts of zinc increased the risk of preterm birth by over 6 times.

samples.src: Yawaitar jan ƙarfe duk da haka ya kasance damuwa ga masu bincike, saboda sakamakon da aka sani na guba.
samples.ref: The large amounts of copper however was a concern for the researchers, because of the known toxic effects.
samples.hyp: A cikin bincikenmu, mun gano cewa ƙwayar cutar ta fi yawa a cikin mutanen da ke da ƙwayar cutar.  Wannan na iya zama saboda mutanen da ke da ƙwayar cutar sun fi yawan shiga cikin ayyukan da ke haifar da ƙwayar cutar.  Haka kuma, mun gano cewa mutanen da ke da ƙwayar cutar sun fi yawan kamuwa da cuta.  Wannan na iya zama saboda mutanen da ke da ƙwayar cutar sun fi yawan kasancewa a cikin yanayi da ke haifar da cuta.

samples.src: Samun mata 181 kawai ne suka shiga cikin binciken ya iyakance ikon masu binciken don gano haɗarin da ke tattare da manyan matakan sinadarin saleniyam, kamar yadda adadin masu shiga binciken ya fi dacewa shi ne mata 600.
samples.ref: Having only 181 women participating in the study limited the researchers’ ability to properly find the risks associated with high levels of selenium, as a more suitable number of participants is 600.

samples.src: Ba a binciki abincin yau da kullum na masu shiga don gano hanyoyin da za a iya samun ma'adanai guda uku ba, kuma ba a rubuta Fihirisar Adadin Nauyin Jikinsu, Body Mass Index (BMI) ba.
samples.ref: The daily diets of the participants were not investigated to find the possible sources of three micronutrients, and their Body Mass Index (BMI) was not recorded.

samples.src: Wannan shi ne nazari na farko da aka yi irinsa na auna tasirin sinadarin saleniyam da jan ƙarfe da kuma sinadarin zin ga mata masu juna biyu a Malawi.
samples.ref: This is the first study of its kind measuring the effects of selenium, copper and zinc in pregnant women in Malawi.
samples.hyp: Binciken ya gudanar da gwano mai daidaito, inda aka auna matakan sinadarin saleniyam, jan ƙarfe, da kuma sinadarin zin a cikin jinin mata 100 da suke da juna biyu, kuma an auna matakan da aka samu da kuma yanayin lafiyar su.

samples.src: Afirka tana da mafi girman matakan haihuwar bakwaini - sama da kashi 18% idan aka kwatanta da ƙasashen Yamma da kashi 5%, don haka masu bincike suna son sanin ko abinci mai gina jiki yana taka rawa.
samples.ref: Africa has some of the highest levels of preterm births - over 18% compared to Western countries at 5%, so researchers want to know if nutrition plays a role.

samples.src: Halayen Gida da Amincewar Wuri da Yankunan Kunkuru mai faɗin baya (Malacochersus tornieri) a ƙasar Kenya
samples.ref: Homing Behavior, Site Fidelity and Territoriality of the Pancake tortoise (Malacochersus tornieri) in Kenya

samples.src: Dabbobi suna nuna halaye na musamman na sarari da na ɗan lokaci waɗanda suke haɓaka rayuwarsu.
samples.ref: Animals exhibit unique spatial and temporal behaviors that enhance their survival.
samples.hyp: Halayen waɗannan suna da alaƙa da tsari na halayen da ke cikin halayen da suka haɗu. A cikin bincikenmu, mun yi amfani da ƙididdiga don ƙididdige yadda halayen dabbobi ke tasirawa kan ƙwayoyin halayen da ke cikin halayen da suka haɗu.

samples.src: Fahimtar irin waɗannan halaye muhimmin mataki ne na kiyayewa da kulawa mai inganci, musamman na nau'o’in da suke fuskantar barazana.
samples.ref: Understanding such behaviors is an important step towards effective conservation and management especially of threatened species.

samples.src: A wannan binciken, mun gwada ko kunkuru mai faɗin baya yana da ikon zuwa gida idan an canza shi kuma mun bincika amincin wurin da yanki na nau'in a cikin wuraren zama na halitta a gundumar Kitui, ƙasar Kenya.
samples.ref: In this study, we experimented on whether the Pancake tortoise had the ability to home if translocated and also investigated on site fidelity and territoriality of the species in the natural habitats in Kitui County, Kenya.
samples.hyp: Mun kuma tantance abubuwan da ke haɗuwa da kankara mai faɗin baya a cikin wuraren zama na halitta.

samples.src: An yi nazarin halayen kunkuru guda 39 da suke zaune a rarrabe a ramukan duwatsu guda 12 daga watan Yuli na shekarar 2020 zuwa Yuni na shekarar 2022 ta hanyar bin diddigin rediyo da tarkon kyamara da haɗuwa da samfurin sikanin matakin rukuni da kuma samfurin ad libitum.
samples.ref: Behavior of 39 tortoises inhabiting 12 spatially separated rock crevices was studied from July 2020 to June 2022 through radio-tracking, camera trapping and combination of group-level scan sampling and ad libitum sampling.
samples.hyp: An gudanar da binciken ƙididdiga don tantance dangantaka tsakanin halayen kunkuru da yanayin yanayi.

samples.src: Goma sha huɗu daga cikin kunkurun an saka musu na'urorin watsa siginar rediyo kuma an canza mudu wuri daga rsmukan gidajensu zuwa wasu ramukan da suke nesa da ramukan gidansu da kuma kula da motsinsu da halayensu.
samples.ref: Fourteen of the tortoises were fitted with radio-transmitters and trans-located from their respective home crevices to other crevices away from their respective home crevices and their movement and behavior monitored.

samples.src: Ban da mata guda biyu kacal da suka dace da sababbin ramuka na matsuguni, duk sauran kunkuru sun yi ƙoƙarin yin gida, inda kashi 46.15% daga cikinsu suke bin hanyarsu ta komawa ramukansu da daidaito kuma 15.38% kuma sun isa ga yankunan da aka yi imanin suna cikin iyakar gidansu.
samples.ref: With an exception of only two females that adapted well to the new crevices of translocation, all the other tortoises attempted homing, with 46.15% of them tracing their way back to their home crevices with accurate precision and 15.38% also reaching areas believed to be within their home range.
samples.hyp: Duk da haka, kashi 38.47% na kunkuru sun sami damar shiga cikin ramukan da ba su dace ba, kuma a cikin wannan ɓangaren, kashi 25.00% sun sami damar komawa cikin ramukan da suka dace.

samples.src: Nasarar gida ba tare da shakka ba yana bayar da shaida mai ƙarfi na amincin wuri a cikin nau’in.
samples.ref: The successful homing indisputably gives evidence of strong site fidelity in the species.
samples.hyp: A cikin ƙungiyar, an gano wuri ɗaya kawai, wanda ke da alaƙa da ƙarancin ƙwayar cuta.

samples.src: Wani bincike game da zama na kunkuru ya nuna cewa babu wani bambanci mai mahimmanci tsakanin yawan kunkuru da aka fara samu a cikin ramuka tare da matsakaicin adadin da ke cikin kwanaki na samfur 162 (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P>0.05), kara tallafawa aminci mai ƙarfi na amincin wuri a cikin nau’in.
samples.ref: An analysis of the tortoise crevice occupancy showed that there was no statistically significant difference between numbers of the tortoises initially present in the crevices with the average number present over 162 sampling days (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P >0.05), further supporting strong site fidelity in the species.

samples.src: A gefe guda kuma abubuwan da suka faru na tarko kyamara da samfurin ad libitum sun kuma tabbatar da kunkuru masu faɗin baya na yanki ne tare da maza da suke kare yankunansu daga sauran maza masu shigowa.
samples.ref: On the other hand camera trapping events and ad libitum sampling also proved the Pancake tortoises to be territorial with males aggressively defending their territories from other incoming males.

samples.ref: The researchers observed groups of pancake tortoises for nearly two years, and set up cameras to record video of the animals when they weren’t watching them.

samples.src: Sun kuma maƙala wa kunkuru guda 14 na’urorin watsa siginar rediyo.

samples.src: Waɗannan ƙananan na’urori ne waɗanda suke ba masu bincike damar bin diddigin motsin dabbobi, da kuma lura da suke zama dare da rana.
samples.ref: These are small devices that allow researchers to track animal movements, and to monitor where they spend their time during the day and night.

samples.src: Daga nan ne masu binciken suka matsar da wasu daga cikin waɗannan kunkuru da aka bi diddigin zuwa wani sabon wuri, domin su yi nazarinsu cikin sauƙi.
samples.ref: The researchers then moved some of these tracked tortoises to a new area, so they could study them more easily.

samples.hyp: Wannan ya nuna cewa kunkuru suna da damar tafiya, kuma suna da damar komawa gida, ko da akwai cikas.

samples.ref: This was when the researchers decided to try moving more of the animals away from their homes, to see if they would show similar ‘homing’ behaviour.

samples.ref: More rifampicin was found in the bodies of patients who received high dose capsules than of those who received intravenous treatment or the standard dose.

samples.src: A faɗar masu binciken, wannan ya nuna cewa, lafiyar majiyyatan da suke fama da cutar sanƙarau na ƙwaƙwalwa za ta iya inganta idan sun sami adadin rifampicin fiye da ƙima.
samples.ref: According to the researchers, this shows that the health of patients suffering from tuberculosis meningitis can be improved if they receive higher doses of rifampicin.

samples.src: Ba kome ba ne idan sun karɓa a matsayin ƙayoyi ko ta cikin jijiya – abu mai muhimmanci shi ne cewa suna karɓar adadi fiye da ƙima, saboda jikinsu yana iya adana yawan adadinsa.
samples.ref: It doesn’t matter if they receive it as pills or intravenously - what matters is that they receive higher doses, because their bodies are then able to store higher concentrations of it.
samples.hyp: A cikin wasu halittu, wannan yana da kyau, amma a wasu, yana da illa.

samples.src: Sakamakon ya goyi bayan sakamakon gwajin da aka yi a ƙasashen Yuganda da kuma Indonesia.

A cikin ƙungiyar da ba su da isassun abinci, kashi 70% sun ce sun sha wahala wajen samun abinci, yayin da kashi 30% sun ce sun sami isassun abinci.

samples.src: Wasu ƙananan gwaji guda biyu a ƙasar Indonesia alal misali sun bayar da shawarar cewa za a iya ceton rayukan wasu majiyyata da yawa idan an ba su adadin rifampicin fiye da ƙima ko dai ta baki ko ta cikin jijiya.
samples.ref: Two small trials in Indonesia for instance suggested that the lives of many more patients can be saved if they are given higher doses of rifampicin either orally or intravenously.

samples.src: Marubuta da dama sun ba da rahoton ingantaccen tasirin gawayi da takin ƙasa akan amfanin ƙasa.
samples.ref: The positive effect of biochar and compost applications on soil fertility has been reported by many authors.
samples.hyp: Gawayi, wanda aka samu ta zafin nama da sauran abubuwa masu ɗaɗi, yana ƙara ƙarfin ƙasa, ƙara adadin ruwa, da kuma ƙara adadin abubuwan da ke daɗa ƙasa. Takin ƙasa, wanda aka samu ta zafin takin, yana ƙara adadin abubuwan da ke daɗa ƙasa, da kuma ƙara adadin ruwa.

samples.src: A wannan binciken, an yi gwajin xakin gwaji na kwanaki 30 ta hanyar amfani da samfuran 120 g na ko wanne na Haplic acrisol wanda aka gyara da gawayin ciyawar masara (cbio), gawayin vawon shinkafa (rbio), gawayin vawon kwakwa (coco300 da coco700) ko takin kaji (taki); da gawayin ruvavven vawon shinkafa (rcocomp) ko gawayin ciyawar masara (cococomp) a matakin gyara na 1% w/w: ƙasa, bi da bi.
samples.ref: In this study, a 30-day laboratory incubation experiment was done using 120 g samples each of a Haplic acrisol amended with corn cob biochar (cbio), rice husk biochar (rbio), coconut husk biochar (coco300 and coco700) or poultry manure compost (compost); and co- composted rice husk biochar (rcocomp) or co-composted corn cob biochar (cococomp) at rates of 1 % w/w amendment: soil, respectively.
samples.hyp:
An rarraba samfuran a cikin 3 nau'o'i, kowannensu da samfuran 4. An yi amfani da wannan hanya don tantance tasirin gawayi akan ƙimomin ƙasa.

In this study, a 30-day pot experiment was conducted using 120 g of each of the following: Haplic acrisol amended with biochar (cbio), rice husk biochar (rbio), coconut shell biochar (coco300 and coco700), or sand (control); and rice husk composite (rcocomp) or corn stover composite (cococomp) at a 1% w/w amendment rate, respectively. The samples were divided into 3 classes, each with 4 samples. This method was used to assess the effect of biochar on soil properties.

samples.src: Wasu gwajejen kan jinyar qasa a cikin binciken sun haɗa da takin kaji da gawayin masara ko vawon shinkafa (1% taki + 1% gawayi: 1% ƙasa w/w), bi da bi, don binciko tasirinsu a kan numfashin ƙasa, pH na ƙasa; qwayar halittar ƙasa; iyawa musaya; jimlar qwayoyin kabon, jimlar sinadarin niturogin da abubuwan da ake samu na niturogin.
samples.ref: Other treatments in the study were combined poultry manure compost and corn cob biochar or rice husk biochar (1 % compost + 1% biochar: 1% soil w/w), respectively, to examine their effects on basal soil respiration, soil pH; soil microbial carbon; cation exchange capacity; total organic carbon, total nitrogen and available nitrogen concentration.

samples.src: Gawayi da takin da aka yi amfani da su kawai ko tare, da gawayin takin ya ƙara pH na ƙasa da 0.28-2.29 pH idan aka kwatanta da qasar da ba a gyara ba.
samples.ref: Biochar and compost applied solely or together, and composted biochar increased soil pH by 0.28–2.29 pH units compared to the un-amended control.
samples.hyp: Gawayin gawayi, a gefe ɗaya, sun ƙara pH na ƙasa da 0.15-0.45 pH.

samples.src: Numfashin qasa da ke fitowa daga takin da aka yi da takin shinkafa ko takin masara, ko haɗaɗɗen gawayi da takin sun fi ƙarfi kan wanda ba a gyara ba, wanda yayi kama da na gawayi kawai.
samples.ref: Basal respiration from the sole compost or composted rice husk, or corn cob biochar or combined biochar and compost were higher than the un-amended control, which was similar to that from the biochar only treatments.

samples.src: TOC a cikin takin da ba gauraya ba da wanda aka haɗa da gawayin masara, wanda aka yi wa jiyya sun fi wand ba a yi wa jinya ba da 37% da 117%, bi da bi.
samples.ref: TOC in the sole compost and combined corn cob biochar and compost treatments were up to 37% and 117% higher, respectively, than the control.
samples.hyp: Ƙididdigar ƙwayoyin gado ta nuna cewa akwai bambance-bambancen tsakanin nau'o'in gawayi.

samples.src: Haɗe-haɗen amfani da gawayin vawon shinkafa da taki ya ƙara MBC da 132% yayin da ƙarin takin da aka haɗa ya qara MBC da 247%, bi da bi, idan aka kwatanta da wanda ba sarrafa ba.
samples.ref: Combined application of rice husk biochar and compost increased MBC by 132% while sole compost addition increased MBC by 247%, respectively, compared to the control.
samples.hyp: Wannan ya nuna cewa haɗe-haɗen gawayi da taki na iya zama hanya mai amfani wajen ƙara ƙarfin ƙasar.

samples.src: A ƙarshe, binciken ya nuna cewa takin da ba a sarrafa ba da wanda aka sarrafa da gawayi, ya qara inganta sigogi ƙasa kamar pH na ƙasa da MBC, da kuma inganta daidaiton C na ƙasa ta hanyar inganta TOC da raguwar C na ƙasa.
samples.ref: In conclusion, the study demonstrated that sole or combined application of compost and biochar, or composted biochar improved soil quality parameters such as soil pH and MBC, and promoted soil C stabilization through enhanced TOC and reduced soil C loss through basal respiration.

samples.ref: Each sample contained specially prepared soil called Haplic acrisol, which was mixed with different combinations of biochars made from corn cob, rice husk or coconut husk, and a poultry manure compost.

samples.src: Sauran samfurori sun ƙunshi cakuxa ƙasa da takin kaji, tare da vawon shinkafa, da ƙwayar masara, bi da bi.
samples.ref: Other samples contained a mix of soil and poultry manure compost , with rice husk biochar, and corn cob biochar, respectively.
samples.hyp: A cikin samfurin, an gano cewa akwai bambance-bambancen da ba a san su ba a cikin ɓangaren 16S rRNA, wanda ke nuni da cewa akwai nau'o'in ƙwayoyin cuta daban-daban a cikin samfurin.

samples.src: Ko wane samfurin ya ƙunshi takin 1%, 1% na ko wane gawayi, domin masu binciken su bincika tasirin ko wane cakuxa a kan ingancin ƙasa.
samples.ref: Each of the samples contained 1 % compost, 1% for each biochar, so that the researchers could investigate the effect of each mixture on soil quality.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun gano cewa ƙara gawayi da takin a cikin ƙasa, ko dai daban ko tare, yana ƙara ƙimar pH na ƙasa daga raka'a 0.28-2.29 pH, idan aka kwatanta da ƙasa mara gauraye.
samples.ref: The researchers found that adding biochar and compost to the soil, either separately or together, increased the pH value of the soil from 0.28–2.29 pH units, compared to unmixed soil.
samples.hyp: Hakanan, ƙara gawayi da takin yana ƙara adadin iska da ruwa a cikin ƙasa, wanda ke taimakawa tsire-tsire.

samples.src: Ƙaruwar pH yana nufin asid ya ragu cikin ƙasar.
samples.ref: An increase in pH means the soil became less acidic.
samples.hyp: Wannan yana da illa ga tsire-tsire, saboda suna buƙatar pH mai kyau don samun abinci. Haka kuma, ƙara yawan gishiri a cikin ƙasa yana da illa ga tsire-tsire, saboda yana hana su samu abinci.

samples.src: Binciken ya gano cewa numfashin, ko kuma mafi qarancin sinadarin kabon da qasa ke fitarwa, yana karuwa ne idan aka haqa takin kaxai, ko kuma idan aka haxa takin da gawayin vawon shinkafa, ko na masara ko gawayin garwaye.
samples.ref: The study found that basal respiration, or the minimum amount of carbon dioxide being released by the soil, increased when either compost alone was added, or when compost was mixed with rice husk, or corn cob biochar or combined biochars.

samples.src: Samfurorin ƙasan sun nuna ƙaruwar jimlar snadarin kabon ɗin da ya kai 37% idan aka yi amfani da takin kaɗai, da ƙaruwar 117% idan aka gauraya gawayin masara da takin.
samples.ref: The soil samples showed an increase in total organic carbon content of 37% when compost alone was used, and an increase of 117% when corn cob biochar was mixed with compost.

samples.src: Adadin motsin ƙwayoyin halitta ya karu da 132% inda ƙasa ke da cakuxar taki da gawayin vawon shinkafa, idan aka kwatanta da karuwar 247% a cikin samfuran ƙasa waɗanda ke da taki kawai.
samples.ref: The amount of microorganism activity increased by 132% where the soil had a mixture of compost and rice husk biochar, compared to an increase of 247% in soil samples that had compost alone.
samples.hyp: Wannan ya nuna cewa haɗin gawayi da taki yana da tasiri sosai wajen ƙara yawan motsin ƙwayoyin halitta.

samples.src: Sakamakon wannan bincike ya nuna cewa yana iya yiwuwa a rage asid xin ƙasa ta hanyar amfani da gawayi, wanda ke da arha kuma yake samuwa cikin sauƙi.
samples.ref: The results of this research show that it is possible to decrease soil acidity using biochar, which is easily and cheaply available.

samples.src: Wannan ya bambanta da tsarin da ake bi na sassauta kasa, wanda ke da tsada kuma da wuya ga kananan manoma a yankin kudu da hamadar Sahara.

samples.hyp: A sakamakon haka, yawanci manoma suna dogon lokaci ana jiran su, wanda hakan ya haifar da rashin daidaito a cikin samarwa da kuma damar kasuwa. Haka kuma, tsarin da ake bi na sassauta kasa yana da ƙarancin damar dawo da su, wanda hakan ya sa manoma su dogon lokaci suna jiran kuɗi, kuma yana ƙara damar samun barna.

samples.src: Sabon Tsarin Fabrin Faiba a Ciwon Gavvai da Alaqarsa da Sava Tsarin Garkuwar Jiki, Kumburi da Daskarewar Jini
