samples.src: Haxarin ciwon zuciya cikin marasa lafiya masu RA yana qaruwa saboda kumburi.
samples.ref: The risk of cardiovascular events in patients with RA is disproportionately heightened as a result of systemic inflammation.
samples.hyp: Wannan kumburi na iya haifar da ciwo a jiki. Haka kuma, bincike ya nuna cewa mutane da suke da ciwon zuciya suna da babban yuwuwar kamuwa da cutar.

samples.src: Zuwa yanzu, ba a san tasirin tsarin garkuwar jiki kan tsarin fabrins ba.
samples.ref: The relative effect of autoimmune-associated citrullination on the structure and thrombotic potential of fibrin(ogen) remains unknown.
samples.hyp: Saboda haka, mun gudanar da bincike don tantance tasirin abubuwan da ke cikin abinci akan ƙwayar jini. Binciken ya nuna cewa abinci mai gina jiki yana da tasiri wajen inganta ƙwayar jini.

samples.src: Saboda haka muka kwatanta aikin hanyoyin jini, kumburi, daskarewa da dunqulewar jini cikin marasa lafiya masu RA da kevavvun hanyoyin lura da alaqar da ke tsakani.
samples.ref: We therefore compared indices of vascular function, inflammation, coagulation and fibrin clot composition in RA patients with healthy controls and evaluated inter-parameter relationships.

samples.src: A kavi samfurin jini daga marasa lafiya masu RA 30 da masu gudummowar sa kai 25 waxanda aka raba bisa shekaru da jinsi.
samples.ref: Blood samples were collected from 30 RA patients and 25 age- and gender-matched healthy volunteers.
samples.hyp: An yi gwajin serum ɗin don ƙayyadadden ƙwayar cuta ta anti-citrullinated peptide (anti-CCP) da kuma ƙwayar cuta ta factor da aka gano a cikin jini (RF).

samples.src: An gwada matakan SAA, CRP, ICAM-1 da VCAM-1 ta hanyar rarrabe sinadaran kariyar jiki.
samples.ref: Levels of SAA, CRP, ICAM-1 and VCAM-1 was measured using a sandwich immunoassay.
samples.hyp: A cikin ƙungiyar gwaji, an gano cewa matakan CRP da ICAM-1 sun ƙaru sosai, yayin da matakan SAA da VCAM-1 sun ƙaru kadan. Wannan ya nuna cewa, a cikin ƙungiyar gwaji, an ƙaruwar ciwo da ƙonewa, yayin da ƙonewa ta ƙasa.

samples.src: An gwada daskarewar jini ta hanyar turombolastogifi.
samples.ref: Whole blood coagulation was assessed using Thromboelastography.
samples.hyp: Turombolastogifi wani abu ne da ke taimakawa wajen hana jini daga rigakafi. An gano cewa, a cikin maza, turombolastogifi ya rage yawan jinin da ke fitowa daga ƙwaƙwalwa a lokacin aikin tiyata. A mata, an gano cewa turombolastogifi ya rage yawan jinin da ke fitowa daga ciki.

samples.src: An binciki hanyoyin fabrin da tsarin fayba ta hanyar amfani na’urar gwajin sinadarai.
samples.ref: Fibrin clot networks and fiber structure was investigated using Scanning Electron Microscopy.
samples.hyp: An gano cewa, a cikin nau’o’in da aka bincaka, an sami bambance-bambancen da ba a san su ba a cikin hanyoyin fabrin, waɗanda ke da alaƙa da bambance-bambancen da aka gano a cikin tsarin fayba. Hakanan, an gano cewa, a cikin nau’o’in da aka bincaka, akwai bambance-bambancen da ba a san su ba a cikin tsarin fayba, waɗanda ke da alaƙa da bambance-bambancen da aka gano a cikin hanyoyin fabrin.

samples.src: An yi amfani da tsarin Sitrulin wajen ganowa da awon yanayin dungulewar jini cikin dungulallen fabrin.
samples.ref: The detection and quantification of citrullination in formed fibrin clots were performed using a fluorescently labeled Citrulline monoclonal antibody with Confocal Microscopy.
samples.hyp: An kuma yi amfani da wannan tsarin wajen tantance yanayin yanayin yanayi a cikin wasu wurare.  A cikin wannan bincike, mun yi amfani da tsarin Sitrulin don tantance yanayin yanayi a cikin yankin Kudancin Najeriya.

samples.src: Taruwar SAA, CRP da ICAM-1 ya fi yawa cikin masu RA kan waxanda ba su da shi.
samples.ref: Concentrations of SAA, CRP and ICAM-1 were significantly elevated in RA patients compared to controls.
samples.hyp: Wannan ya nuna cewa, ƙwayoyin jijiya na iya taka rawa a cikin ci gaban cutar RA. Hakanan, ƙarin gwaje-gwaje na biyo baya ne ake buƙata don tantance matakan da ƙwayoyin jijiya ke taka a cikin ci gaban cutar RA.

samples.src: Hanyoyin TEG da suke da alaqa da soma daskara (R and K), yawan cakuxar fabrin (α-Angle), da lokacin ya ke xauka kafin daskarewar jini sun ragu cikin marasa lafiya masu RA.
samples.ref: TEG parameters relating to coagulation initiation (R and K), rate of fibrin cross-linking (α-Angle), and time to reach maximum thrombus generation (TMRTG) were attenuated in RA patients.
samples.hyp: A cikin marasa lafiya, TEG ya nuna cewa akwai wani abu da ke hana daskara jini, kuma wannan abu ba shi da alaqa da yawan cakuxar fabrin.

samples.src: Ba a samu bambamcin qiyasi ba cikin abubuwa masu alaqa da qarfin dunqulellen jini (MA, MRTG, TGG) tsakani masu RA da waxanda ba su da shi.
samples.ref: Parameters relating to clot strength (MA, MRTG, TGG) did not statistically differ between RA and controls.
samples.hyp: Duk da haka, an gano bambamcin ƙima a cikin ƙayayyakin jini, wanda ya haɗa da ƙima mai ƙarfi a cikin ƙwayoyin jini (WBC) da ƙima mai ƙarfi a cikin jini (serum).

samples.src: Ilimin bambanta abubuwa ya nuna alaqa mai qarfi tsakanin farkon cuta (CRP, SAA) da abubuwa masu nuna ingancin sinadarai TEG masu daidaita garkuwar jiki.
samples.ref: Logistic regression modelling revealed stronger association between acute phase reactants (CRP, SAA) with TEG parameters than endothelial function markers.
samples.hyp: Wannan ya nuna cewa, a cikin yanayin cuta, jikin mutum yana ƙara samar da CRP da SAA, wanda ke haifar da canje-canje a cikin sinadarai TEG.

samples.src: Gwajin na’urar awo ya nuna karfin tsarin fabrin cikin masu RA kan waxanda ba su da shi 214 (170-285) kan 120 (100-144) nm, p<0.0001, resho =22.7).
samples.ref: Microscopic analysis revealed denser networks of thicker fibrin fibers in RA patients compared to controls [median (interquartile range) 214 (170-285) vs 120 (100-144) nm respectively, p<0.0001, Odds ratio=22.7).
samples.hyp: Hakanan, an gano cewa tsarin fabrin yana da ƙarfin 140 (110-170) kan 80 (70-90) nm a cikin ƙwayoyin da ke cikin jini na masu cuta, resho = 17.5, p<0.0001.

samples.src: Gano guraben sauye-sauyen sinadarai cikin dunqulallen fabrin na masu RA, wanda bai kai yawan na marasa ba (p<0.05, ko =2.2).
samples.ref: Detection of multiple citrullinated regions within fibrin clot structures in RA patients, which was less prevalent in control samples (p<0.05, OR=2.2).
samples.hyp: A cikin ƙungiyar mai jini, an gano sauye-sauyen sinadarai guda 12 a cikin 100% na samfuran, yayin da a cikin ƙungiyar ba mai jini, an gano sauye-sauyen sinadarai guda 8 a cikin 75% na samfuran.

samples.src: Masu cutar RA na nuna samun alamar dunqulewar jini wanda ya sava da sakamakon bincike kan yanayin wasu kumburin.
samples.ref: Patients with active RA display a coagulation profile that is dissimilar to general findings associated with other inflammatory conditions.
samples.hyp: A wasu lokuta, wannan alamar na iya zama mai tsanani, kuma yana iya haifar da kumburi a cikin jini. Wannan kumburi a cikin jini na iya zama mai wahala, kuma yana iya haifar da matsaloli da yawa.

samples.src: Canja yanayin sinadarin protin ta hanyar sauyawar garkuwar jiki na iya taimakawa wajen yanayin fabrin da qaruwar dungulewar jinin cikin jijiya ga masu RA.
samples.ref: The alteration of protein structures by autoimmune linked citrullination could play a role in determining the structure of fibrin and the potential of conferring a heightened thrombotic risk in RA patients.
samples.hyp: A cikin wannan binciken, mun yi amfani da hanyar ƙididdiga don ƙididdige yadda sauyin yanayin sinadarin protin na iya taimakawa wajen yanayin fabrin da qaruwar dungulewar jinin cikin jijiya ga masu RA.

samples.src: Dungulewar jinni cikin masu ciwon gavvai manuniya ce kan yanda suke iya kamuwa da bugun zuciya da garsa.
samples.ref: Blood clotting in arthritis patients may explain their increased risk for heart attack, stroke

samples.src: Sabon bincike kan ciwon gaba ya qara baiyanar da fahimta kan yiwuwar alaqa tsakanin cutar da haxarin kamuwa da ciwon zuciya.
samples.ref: New research into rheumatoid arthritis has provided a better understanding of potential links between this condition and increased cardiovascular disease risk.
samples.hyp: Binciken, wanda aka buga a mujallar 'Arthritis & Rheumatology', ya bita da mutane sama da 20,000, kuma ya gano cewa mutanen da ke da ciwon gaba sun da alama sun fi yawan kamuwa da cutar.  Wannan na iya zama saboda ciwon gaba yana haifar da ciwon ƙwaƙwalwa, wanda zai iya haifar da haxarin kamuwa da cutar.  Haka kuma, binciken ya gano cewa mutanen da ke da ciwon gaba sun fi yawan kamuwa da wasu matsalolin lafiya, irin su sukari da ƙoƙarin numfashi, waɗanda kuma za su iya haxarin kamuwa da cutar.  Wannan binciken ya jaddada mahimmancin kula da lafiya ga mutanen da ke da ciwon gaba, da kuma gudanar da bincike don fahimtar alaka tsakanin ciwon gaba da haxarin kamuwa da cutar.

samples.src: Ciwon gaba (RA) ciwo ne mai zafi da tsanani sosai wanda ke faruwa indan garkuwan jiki ya sava tsari, kuma yana da alaqa da kumburi a duk gavvan jiki.
samples.ref: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a painful and debilitating autoimmune condition, associated with inflammation in the joints and throughout the body.
samples.hyp: A cikin bincikenmu, mun yi amfani da ƙididdigar ƙwayoyin gado don tantance bambance-bambancen ƴan adam da ke da RA da waɗanda ba su da ciwo. Mun kuma gano cewa akwai bambance-bambancen da ke cikin ƙwayoyin gado na mutanen da ke da ciwon gaba, waɗanda ke da alaƙa da ciwon.

samples.src: Da daxewa masana kimiyya sun san cewa 50% na masu wannan cutar na iya kamuwa da cutar zuciya (CVD) mai haddasa garsa da bugun zuciya.
samples.ref: For some time now, scientists have known that sufferers of the disease also have a 50% higher risk of cardiovascular disease (CVD) outcomes – like strokes or heart attacks.
samples.hyp: Saboda haka, binciken da ake yi a yanzu ya yi ƙoƙarin tantance ko akwai alaka tsakanin cutar da cutar zuciya.

samples.src: Hatsarin da ya fi girma shi ne alaqar kumburi da hanyar dunqulewar jini.
samples.ref: A key factor in that risk is the effect inflammation has on the blood clotting process.
samples.hyp: Hakanan, an gano cewa kumburi a cikin jini yana da alaƙa da yawan adadin ƙwayoyin jini masu ƙarfi.

samples.src: A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun zaqulo wannan alaqar, don gano takamammen abin da ya sa RA ke qara haxarin CVD.
samples.ref: In this study, researchers investigated this relationship, to find out exactly why RA heightens CVD risk.
samples.hyp: Sun yi amfani da bayanan da aka samu daga wani binciken da aka yi a Amurka, wanda ya hada da kusan mutane 2,000, kuma sun yi amfani da takamaiman hanyoyin bincike don tantance ko akwai alaka tsakanin RA da haxarin CVD. Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa akwai alaka mai mahimmanci tsakanin RA da haxarin CVD, kuma cewa mutanen da ke da RA sun fi yawan kamuwa da cututtukan zuciya.

samples.src: A taqaice dai, masu binciken sun gwada illar kumburi da canjin tsarin protin da ke da alaqa da dunqulewar jini wanda ake kira fibrins.
samples.ref: More specifically, the researchers examined the effects of inflammation and structural changes on specific proteins associated with blood-clotting, called fibrins.
samples.hyp: Sannan, sun gano cewa canjin da aka gano a cikin protin yana da alaqa da yawan jini.

samples.src: Waxannan sinadaran protin na faruwa ne kamar dogon layi mai sarqe da juma, saboda haka canjawar fabirins xin na iya shafar hanyoyin dunqulewar jini kai tsaye.
samples.ref: These proteins occur as long chains that form the basic “mesh-work” for blood clots, so any changes to the fibrins themselves could have knock-on effects for the clotting process overall.

samples.src: Masu bincike sun kwatatanta jinin marasa lafiya masu RA da na mutane masu lafiya.
samples.ref: Researchers compared blood samples of RA patients to samples from healthy individuals.
samples.hyp: Sun gano cewa akwai bambance-bambance tsakanin su. A cikin marasa lafiya, an gano ƙarancin huɗaɓa (albumin) da ƙarin ƙwayoyin jini (erythrocytes) a cikin jinin. Haka kuma, an gano cewa akwai ƙarin ƙwayoyin jini masu ƙarfi (leukocytes) a cikin jinin marasa lafiya.

samples.src: A ko wane yanayi, masu binciken na neman alamu cikin jini waxanda suke nuna kumburi, da dukkan bambamce-bambamce da cikin hanyoyin dunqulewar jiki da zai qara hatsarin CVD.
samples.ref: In each case, the researchers were looking for “markers” in the blood that indicate inflammation, as well as for any unusual differences in the normal clotting process that could heighten CVD risk.

samples.src: An gwada dunqulallen jinin ta hanyar na’urar gwaji, don gano sauye-sauye cikin tsarin protin nau’in fabrin.
samples.ref: The clots themselves were also analysed microscopically, to identify any changes to the structure of their fibrin proteins.
samples.hyp: An kuma gano cewa, a cikin dukkanin samfurin, an samu sauye-sauye guda 23 a cikin tsarin protin, waɗanda 11 daga cikinsu ne kawai suka canza a cikin dukkanin samfurin.

samples.src: Masanan sun lura da cewa jin marasa lafiya masu RA ya fi saurin dunqulewa a kan na masu lafiya, kuma irin sinadaran protin da aka yi su da su ya fi na fabrins da aka sani kawri.
samples.ref: The researchers noticed that clots from RA patients formed faster than those in healthy individuals, and that the protein strands they were made of were also significantly thicker than normal fibrins.
samples.hyp: Hakanan, an gano cewa mutanen da ke da bambance-bambancen genetic a cikin gene na HLA-DRB1 sun fi yuwuwar samun RA.

samples.src: Akwai kuma sauye-sauyen amino asit da aka yi fabrin furotin da su, wanda ke haddasa tashin farkuwar jiki, wanda hakan na jawo qaruwar kumburi.
samples.ref: There were also changes to the amino acids that make up the fibrin proteins, which caused them to trigger the body’s immune response, leading to further inflammation.

samples.src: Kafin wannan binciken, wasu masu bincike sun lura da sauye-sauyen yanayin amino asid na fabrins a gavaven marasa lafiya masu RA, amma wannan ne karo ne farko na farko da masu bincike suka ga tasiri mai kama da juna cikin jini.
samples.ref: Other researchers have noticed changes to the amino acid structure of fibrins in the joints of RA patients before, but this is the first time researchers have seen the same effect in blood.

samples.src: Haxe da wasu sauye-sauye da aka gani cikin dunqulallen jini, sakamakon zai taimaka wa masana kimiyya wajen samun cikakken fahimtar alaqa tsakanin RA da CVD, da yanda za a gane alamun waxannan cutuka da wuri.
samples.ref: Combined with the other changes seen in the blood clots, the findings may help scientists develop a deeper understanding of the relationship between RA and CVD, and how to detect early signs of these diseases.
samples.hyp: Haka kuma, binciken ya nuna cewa akwai bambanci mai mahimmanci a tsakanin maza da mata a wajen yawan sauye-sauye da aka gani a cikin dunqulallen jini.

samples.src: Duk da cewar wannan sakamakon na da alfanu, ya kamata a sani cewa yawan abin bincike da aka yi amfani da su kaxan ne idan aka kwatanta shi wasu binciken.
samples.ref: Though these initial results are promising, it’s worth noting that the sample size for the study was comparatively small.
samples.hyp: Hakanan, binciken ya yi amfani da hanyar da ta fi dacewa ga mutanen da ke zaune a birni, wanda hakan na iya shafar sakamakun. Bugu da kari, ba a lura da bambance-bambancen launin kai na mutane a cikin binciken.

samples.src: Kuma masu binciken sun ce ta iya yiwuwa hanyoyin bincike da suka yi amfani da su wajen gano sauye-sauyen amino asid cikin sinadaran protin ya xauko wasu abubuwa da ba su da alaqa, wanda hakan na nufin ana buqatar qarin gwaje-gwaje na musamman kan fabrins don tabbatar da wannan sakamakon nan gaba.
samples.ref: The researchers also mentioned that the method they used to detect amino acid changes in the proteins could also have picked up results from unrelated substances, meaning that more specific tests targeting fibrins would be needed to confirm the result in future.

samples.src: Zuwa gaba, fahimtar cakuxaxxar alaqa tsakanin RA da yawaitar haxarin CVD zai kyautata samun sauqi ga marasa lafiya masu RA tunda muna koyon ganowa da magance waxannnan cutuka.
samples.ref: In the long run, understanding the complex links between RA and increased CVD risk may improve outcomes for RA patients as we learn to identify and treat these diseases more effectively.

samples.src: Masu bincike daga Afirka ta Kudu, Denmak da Ingila na cikin masu binciken nan, wanda Qungiyar Bincike kan Magani ta Afirka ta Kudu ta xauki nauyinsa.
samples.ref: Researchers from South Africa, Denmark and the United Kingdom were involved in this study, which was funded by the South African Medical Research Council.
samples.hyp: An gudanar da binciken a asibitai guda 15 a Afirka ta Kudu, wanda ya hada da mutane 1,000,000. An gano cewa mutanen da suka yi amfani da rigakafin cuta sun fi kyau a cikin tsawon rayuwa, kuma sun fi kyau a cikin lafiyar gaba.

samples.src: Hasashen yanayi na yanayin ruwa don masu amfani da bakin teku – fahimta, amfani da ɗauka

samples.ref: The present study aims to address a disconnect between science and the public in the form of a potential misalignment in the supply and demand of information known as the usability gap.
samples.hyp: Domin haka, mun ƙara ƙara ƙayyadaddun bayanan da aka samu a cikin binciken da aka yi a cikin ƙasar nan, tare da ƙayyadaddun bayanan da aka samu a cikin binciken da aka yi a cikin ƙasashen duniya, domin samar da ƙayyadaddun bayanan da za a iya amfani da su a cikin binciken da za a yi a cikin ƙasashen duniya. samples.src: A wannan yanayin, mun bincika bayanan yanayi na ruwa (metocean) kamar yadda masu amfani suka fahimta a cikin ƙasashen Kudancin Hemisphere guda biyu:

Translation:
In this study, we used data from a survey conducted in South Africa, which examined the prevalence of tick-borne diseases in humans. We also used data from a global survey, which examined the prevalence of ticks in animals. We used the data we collected to determine whether there was a correlation between the prevalence of ticks in humans and animals, and the prevalence of tick-borne diseases in humans.

samples.src: Nazarin ƙwayoyin cututtuka a matsayin nau’in baƙin halittu masu mamaya bai samu kulawa mai yawa a fannin kimiyyar mamayewa ba.

Mun kuma yi nazari game da yadda ƙwayoyin cututtuka ke tasirama haɓakawa da yaɗuwa na cututtuka a cikin dabbobi.

samples.src: Ƙwayoyin cuta da aka ɓullo da su suna iya yin tasiri mai tsanani a kan rayayyun halittu, da halittun da suke zaune, da kuma tattalin arzikin da halittun suke tallafawa.

samples.src: Babban tasirin da ya fi ɗaukar hankali a yau shi ne na gudawar shanu, wanda ya yi sanadiyyar mutuwar miliyoyin shanu, kuma a zahiri ya halaka wasu nau’o’in namun daji daga manyan sassan kudancin Afirka.

samples.src: Baƙin haure da ‘yan gudun hijirar da suke tserewa zuwa ƙasashen waje sukan fuskanci damuwa bayan tashin hankali da sauran batutuwan lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa.
samples.ref: Migrants and refugees escaping to foreign countries often experience ongoing post-traumatic stress and other mental health issues.

samples.src: A yayin da yawancin waɗannan batutuwan na faruwa ne sakamakon abubuwan da suka faru a ƙasashensu, masana kimiyya sun ce yana da mahimmanci kuma a san cewa damuwa da zama a sabuwar ƙasa suna iya ƙara matsalar.
samples.ref: While many of these issues are caused by things that happened in their home countries, scientists say it’s also important to acknowledge that the stress of living in a new country can add to the problem.

samples.src: Kamar yadda bincike daban-daban suka nuna, damuwa da juyayi kuma matsalar damuwa bayan tashin hankali (PTSD) duk batutuwan lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa ne waɗanda suke gama-gari a tsakanin baƙin haure da kuma ‘yan gudun hijira.
samples.ref: According to various studies, depression, anxiety, and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) are all common mental health issues among migrants and refugees.
samples.hyp: Baƙin haure da ‘yan gudun hijira suna fuskantar ƙalubalun da ba su da misaltuwa, waɗanda ke haifar da damuwa, tashin hankali, da kuma damuwa bayan tashin hankali. Waɗannan kalubalun sun haɗa da rasa gida, rasa iyalai da abokai, da kuma fuskantar tashin hankali.

samples.src: PTSD yana faruwa ne yawanci a sakamakon tsira mai haɗari ko abubuwan da suka faru na ɓarna, kuma mutane sukan fuskanci sakamakon abubuwan da suka faru marasa kyau na tsawon watanni, ko ma na shekaru.
samples.ref: PTSD is usually the result of surviving dangerous or damaging events, and people often experience the after-effects of those negative events for months, or even years.

samples.src: A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun so su fahimci abubuwa daban-daban waɗanda suke taka rawa a cikin matsalolin lafiyar ƙwaƙwala na baƙon haure kamar PTSD.
samples.ref: In this study, researchers wanted to understand the different factors that play a role in migrant mental health problems like PTSD.
samples.hyp: Don haka, sun yi amfani da hanyoyin ƙididdiga don ƙididdige yadda abubuwa kamar ƙalubalun rayuwa, yanayin ruhaniya, da kuma yanayin jama'a ke shafar lafiyar ƙwaƙwala.  Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa akwai alaka mai ƙarfi tsakanin waɗannan abubuwa da lafiyar ƙwaƙwala.

samples.src: Domin haka, sun gudanar da wani nau'i na nazari da ake kira bita, inda suka taƙaita bayanai daga wasu nazari da yawa a kan wannan batu, don gano abubuwan da aka saba ko kuma jigogi.
samples.ref: They therefore conducted a type of study called a review, where they summarised information from multiple other studies on the subject, to find common trends or themes.

samples.src: A mafi yawancin lokuta, al’amuran lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwar baƙon haure sun kasance sakamakon bala'o'i masu ban tsoro kamar yaƙi da asarar waɗanda suke ƙauna, ko harin jiki da ya faru a ƙasashensu na asali.
samples.ref: In many cases, migrant mental health issues were the result of traumatic events like war, the loss of loved ones, or physical assault that took place in their home countries.
samples.hyp: Matsalolin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwar baƙon haure sun haɗa da cutar ƙwaƙwalwa, damuwa, cutar tunani, da kuma cututtukan addana tunani.  Wannan bincike ya yi ƙoƙarin tantance ko akwai bambance-bambancen ƙididdiga mai mahimmanci a tsakanin ƙwaƙwalwar baƙon haure da aka samu a cikin ƙasashe daban-daban, da kuma yadda waɗannan bambancin ke shafar lafiyar su.

samples.src: A yayin da waɗannan mutane suka bar waɗannan yanayi, sun fuskanci tafiye-tafiye masu wuya, amma sai suka ji daɗi a lokacin da suka isa sabuwar ƙasa.
samples.ref: When these people left those situations, they faced difficult journeys but then felt relief when they reached a new country.
samples.hyp: Bayan haka, sun yi ƙoƙarin daidaita rayuwarsu da al'adun sabuwar ƙasa, kuma sun yi ƙaura a cikin sabuwar ƙasa.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun ce, duk da haka, wannan taimako yakan kasance na wucin gadi, saboda bakin haure sun fuskanci wasu sabbin kalubale bayan sun ƙaura.
samples.ref: The researchers said, however, that this relief was often temporary, because migrants faced new challenges after relocating.
samples.hyp: Waɗannan kalubale sun haɗa da wahalar samun aiki, samun gida, da samun kula da lafiya.  A sakamakon haka, yawanci, bakin haure sun fi ƙaunarta su zauna a cikin ƙasashe da suka bar, ko kuma su yi ƙoƙarin koma gida.

samples.src: Sun gano cewa sau da yawa bakin haure suna fuskantar wahala a sabuwar kasar ma, musamman idan ba su fahimci yaren ba, ko kuma suna da wahalar daidaita al'adun.
samples.ref: They found that migrants often had a difficult time in the new country as well, especially if they didn’t understand the language, or had a hard time adapting to the culture.
samples.hyp: Wannan yana iya haifar da damuwa, damuwa, da rashin daidaito, wanda ke haifar da ƙalubale a cikin ayyukan su.  Don haka, yana da mahimmanci a samar da horo da goyan bayan da suka dace don taimaka wa bakin haure don samun nasara a sabbin wurare.

samples.src: A lokacin da mutane suka isa ƙasar ba bisa ƙa'ida ba, ko kuma suke ƙoƙarin samun mafaka, su ma sun fuskanci matsalolin shari'a, kuma galibi suna fuskantar wahalar samun sabis kamar na kiwon lafiya.
samples.ref: When people had reached the country illegally, or were trying to gain asylum, they also had to deal with legal problems, and often had a hard time accessing services like healthcare.
samples.hyp: Saboda haka, yana da mahimmanci a samar da hanyoyin da za su kare hakkin mutane, da kuma tabbatar da cewa suna samun sabobin da suke buƙata.

samples.src: Ga wasu, wariyar launin fata da wariya a sabuwar ƙasarsu ta ƙara musu jin cewa ba su da aminci, kuma da yawa sun bar ’yan’uwa a baya kuma su kaɗai ne.
samples.ref: For some, racism and discrimination in their new country added to their feelings of being unsafe, and many had left family members behind and were alone.

samples.src: Waɗannan abubuwan sun bayar da gudummawa ga ci gaba da matsalolin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa, ko da da zarar waɗannan baƙin hauren sun kasance a cikin yanayi mafi aminci fiye da na ƙasarsu.
samples.ref: These factors contributed to ongoing mental health problems, even once these migrants were in a safer situation than the one in their home country.
samples.hyp: Hakanan, an gano cewa waɗannan abubuwan suna da alaƙa da ƙarin damar kamuwa da cuta, ƙalubalagen tunani, da kuma ƙalubalagen tunani.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun ƙara da cewa baƙin haure na da dabaru daban-daban na tunkarar waɗannan matsalolin, tun daga tsara yadda za su iya magance su a tsanke, zuwa neman taimako daga wasu a cikin al’ummarsu, ko ta hanyoyin da ba su dace ba kamar shaye-shaye.
samples.ref: The researchers added that migrants had many different strategies for dealing with these problems, from carefully planning how they could tackle them, to seeking out help from others in their community, or more negative approaches like substance abuse.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun ce ana buƙatar ƙarin bincike a kan dukkan matakai na tafiyar baƙin haure.
samples.ref: The researchers say that more research is needed on all stages of the migrant journey.
samples.hyp: Ba a san yadda jinin baƙin haure ke shafar lafiyar ɗan'adam ba. Hakanan, ba a san yadda baƙin haure ke shafar muhittacin da ake samu ba.

samples.src: Musamman, yana da mahimmanci a bincika abubuwan da suke shafar lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa a cikin ƙasashensu na asali, amma haka ma bayan dogon lokaci a cikin sababbin ƙasashensu.
samples.ref: Specifically, it’s important to investigate factors affecting mental health in people’s home countries, but also over the long-term in their new countries.
samples.hyp: Wannan ya haɗa da bincika yadda yanayin zamantakewa, al'adu, da ƙalubalun lafiyar jama'a ke shafar lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa.  Hakanan yana da kyau a bincika tasirarmasa ga yara, matan da ke jima'i, da kuma waɗanda suka tashi.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun ƙara da cewa tafiye-tafiyen mutane daga Afirka zuwa Turai tana buƙatar ƙarin kulawa daga masu bincike.
samples.ref: They add that the journeys of people moving from Africa to Europe need more detailed attention from researchers.

samples.src: Wannan binciken haɗin gwiwa ne tsakanin masana kimiyya da suke Afirka ta Kudu da kuma Jamus, kuma wani ɓangare ne na wani littafi a kan abubuwan da suka shafi baƙin haure na Afirka da suke zaune a ƙasashen Turai.
samples.ref: This study was a collaboration between scientists based in South Africa and Germany, and forms part of a book on the experiences of African migrants living in European countries.
samples.hyp: Binciken ya yi amfani da bayanan da aka samu daga gwaje-gwaje da aka yi a cikin shekarar 2022, kuma ya duba yadda yanayin rayuwa, da ilimi, da kuma ayyukan da mutane suke yi, ke shafar lafiyar mutanen baƙin haure. Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa akwai bambance-bambance tsakanin lafiyar mutanen baƙin haure da suka zauna a Turai, kuma wannan bambance-bambancen ya danganta da yanayin rayuwarsu.

samples.src: Kasancewa da Dagewar Amblyomma Hebraeum Yana Ƙara Kumburin Zuciya a Gundumar Kudancin Ƙasar Botswana
samples.ref: Presence and Persistence of Amblyomma Hebraeum Augments the Burden of Heartwater in the Southern District of Botswana

samples.src: Kumburin zuciya cuta ce ta kaska, cutar haemoparasitic wacce ke da yiwuwar iyakance ci gaban kasuwancin noma a ƙasar Botswana.
samples.ref: Heartwater is a tick-borne, haemoparasitic disease that has the potential to limit the growth of agro-businesses in Botswana.

samples.src: Ana danganta wannan barazana ga samar da abinci na ƙasa da ƙarancin noma da kuma mace-macen dabbobi a cikin noman da ba su da yawa fiye da gonakin kasuwanci.
samples.ref: This threat to national food security is attributed to low production and mortality of livestock in subsistence farming of small stock than in commercial farms.

samples.src: Wannan binciken yana ba da ra'ayi game da nauyin cutar kumburin zuciya a cikin ƙasar Botswana.
samples.ref: This study gives a view of the epidemiological burden of heartwater in Botswana.
samples.hyp: An gudanar da binciken a asibitocin da ke cikin birnin Gaborone, kuma an yi amfani da bayanan da aka samu daga gwaje-gwaje da aka yi wa mutane. Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa cutar kumburin zuciya ce ta uku mafi yawa a cikin mutanen Botswana. Haka kuma, an gano cewa mutanen da ke da cutar kumburin zuciya sun fi yawan mutuwa fiye da wadanda ba su da cutar.

samples.src: An gano kaska masu cin abinci daga dabbobin da aka ajiye a gundumomi huɗu na Kudancin Botswana ta hanyar nazarin halittu da ƙwayoyin cuta.
samples.ref: Feeding ticks on livestock kept in four Southern sub-districts of Botswana were identified through morphological and molecular analysis.
samples.hyp: An gano kaskun da ke cikin jinin da aka ajiye a gundumomi huɗu, wanda ya nuna cewa kaskun suna da yuwuwar zama a cikin dabbobin da ke cikin wannan yanki. Hakanan, an gano cuta a cikin wasu dabbobi, wanda ya nuna cewa akwai babban damari na kamuwa da cuta a wannan yanki.

samples.src: An tattauna da manoma a kan yadda ake tafiyar da matsalar cutar kumburin zuciya a ƙananan hukumominsu.
samples.ref: Farmers were interviewed on the management of the heartwater burden within their respective sub-districts.
samples.hyp: An gano cewa, a cikin ƙananan hukumomin, manoma sun fi damuwa da matsalolin da suka shafi aikin gona, kamar ƙarancin ruwa da ƙarancin ƙoƙon gona, fiye da damuwa game da cutar kumburin zuciya. Duk da haka, manoma sun gamsu da cewa, idan sun sami damar samun ilimi game da cutar, za su iya ɗaukar matakai don hana ta.

samples.src: An tattara rahotannin cututtukan dabbobi domin tantance yawan aukuwar a cikin Gundumar Kudancin Ƙasar Botswana.
samples.ref: Veterinary clinical case reports were collected to assess the frequency of cases across the Southern District of Botswana.
samples.hyp: An yi amfani da tsarin ƙididdiga don ƙididdige yawan aukuwar cututtuka, kuma an gano cewa cutar cutar da ta fi yawa ita ce cutar ƙwayar cuta, wacce ta fi yawa a cikin dabbobin gona.

samples.src: Sakamakon binciken ya bayyana; faɗin rarraba Amblyomma hebraeum a cikin dukkanin gundumomi huɗu da aka yi nazari, sannu a hankali ƙaruwa a kowace shekara a cikin aukuwar cutar kumburin zuciya a cikin gundumar Moshupa da kuma nunin ƙaruwar tasiri a kan nau’in caprine na asali duk da ƙoƙarin shawo kan masu yaɗa cutar da kashi 63% na manoma da aka tattauna da su.
samples.ref: Outcomes of the study revealed; a wide distribution of Amblyomma hebraeum in all four studied sub-districts, gradual annual increase in heartwater cases in Moshupa sub-district and indication of increased impact on indigenous caprine species despite the effort to control vectors by 63% of interviewed farmers.

samples.src: Amblyomma hebraeum, babban jigon Ehrlichia ruminantium a Kudancin Afirka yana yaɗuwa a yankin Kudancin ƙasar Botswana kuma don haka yana haifar da ƙalubale ga yawan amfanin dabbobi a wannan gundumar, kuma wataƙila, a wasu wurare a cikin ƙasar inda kaska take mamaye dabbobi.
samples.ref: Amblyomma hebraeum, the principal vector of Ehrlichia ruminantium in Southern Africa is widely distributed in the Southern District of Botswana and thus poses a challenge to livestock productivity in this district and, perhaps, elsewhere in the country where the tick infests livestock.

samples.src: Don haka, akwai buƙatar a sake yin nazari kan hanyoyin magance kaska da nufin rage nauyin cutar kumburin zuciya musamman a cikin tumaki da awaki.
samples.ref: There is therefore a need to re-examine the existing tick control interventions with an intention to reduce the heartwater disease burden particularly in sheep and goats.

samples.src: Yawan kaska a kudancin ƙasar Botswana yana ƙara tsananta cutar kumburin zuciya a cikin dabbobi
samples.ref: High numbers of ticks in southern Botswana worsens heartwater disease in livestock
samples.hyp: .  Ƙarancin ƙwayar cuta da ke cikin jini (CD4) da kuma yawan ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin jini (viral load) sun ƙaru a cikin dabbobin da suka kamu da cuta.  Haka kuma, an gano kumburi a cikin ƙwayar jini.

samples.src: Wannan binciken ya bayar da rahoto a kan yawaitar kaska da cutar kumburin zuciya a kudancin Botswana a tsakanin shekarar 2017 da shekarar 2019.
samples.ref: This study reports on the widespread burden of ticks and heartwater disease in southern Botswana between 2017 and 2019.
samples.hyp: An yi amfani da bayanan da aka samu daga asibitai da kuma wuraren kula da lafiya don tantance yawan cutar da kuma abubuwan da ke haifar da ita. Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa akwai karuwar yawan cutar kumburin zuciya a yankin, kuma wannan ya danganta da rashin tsafta da kuma rashin samun isassun kayan aiki.

samples.src: Sakamakon binciken zai iya taimaka wa gwamnati da manoma su tsara tsare-tsare domin magance cutar kumburin zuciya.
samples.ref: The results of the study could help the government and farmers make plans to better control heartwater disease.

samples.src: Wasu kaska suna ɗauke da ƙwayar cuta mai suna Ehrlichia ruminantium, wadda take haifar da wata cuta da aka sani da cutar kumburin zuciya a cikin shanu fa tumaki da kuma awaki.
samples.ref: Certain ticks carry a bacteria called Ehrlichia ruminantium, which causes a disease known as heartwater in cattle, sheep and goats.
samples.hyp: Kuma, wannan kaska tana iya haifar da hawan jini a cikin mutane.

samples.src: Wannan ƙwayar cuta kaska ce, ma'ana tana cin abinci daga sauran halittu masu rai kamar dabbobi, kuma suna cutar da su.
samples.ref: This bacteria is a parasite, meaning that it feeds off other living organisms like livestock, causing them harm.
samples.hyp: Kuma wannan cutar tana iya haifar da cututtuka masu tsanani a cikin mutane.

samples.src: Dabbobin da suke fama da cutar kumburin zuciya yawanci suna da zafin jiki mai yawa, suna rasa ci, suna samun matsalar numfashi, kuma suna iya mutuwa ma a ƙarshe.
samples.ref: Livestock suffering with heartwater disease usually have a high body temperature, lose their appetite, have breathing problems, and may eventually die.
samples.hyp: A cikin bincikenmu, mun gano cewa amfani da maganin 'yan adadi na 'yan adadi na furotin na iya inganta yanayin lafiyar dabbobin da ke fama da cutar kumburi.  Mun kuma gano cewa, a wasu lokuta, maganin na iya kawar da cutar.

samples.src: Cutar kumburin zuciya ta zama ruwan dare a kudancin ƙasar Botswana, kuma manoman yankin na asarar dabbobinsu sakamakon kamuwa da cutar.
samples.ref: Heartwater is very common in the southern part of Botswana, and farmers in that area are losing their livestock to the disease.
samples.hyp: Bincike da aka gudanar a yankin ya nuna cewa cutar ta iya zama sakamakon kumburi a cikin jinin dabbobi, wanda ke haifar da haɓaka ƙwayoyin cuta.

samples.src: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun binciki yawaitar cutar kumburin zuciya a kudancin ƙasar Botswana.
samples.ref: In this study, researchers investigated the burden of heartwater in southern Botswana.
samples.hyp: Sun gano cewa yawan matan da ke da cutar kumburi a wannan yanki ya fi yawan maza. Hakanan, sun gano cewa akwai dangantaka tsakanin cutar kumburi da hawan jini.

samples.src: Da farko sun tattara da ƙirga da kuma gano kaska daga shanu da tumaki da awaki don kwatanta adadin kaska da suke ɗauke da ciwon kumburin zuciya da sauran kaska.
samples.ref: They first collected, counted and identified ticks from cattle, sheep and goats to compare the number of ticks carrying the heartwater parasite to other ticks.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun kuma yi hira da wasu manoma a kan abubuwan da suka samu game da cutar kumburin zuciya, kuma sun tattara wasu rahotannin cutar kumburin zuciya daga ofishin kula da dabbobi (lafiyar dabbobi).
samples.ref: The researchers also interviewed some farmers on their experiences with heartwater, and collected some heartwater reports from the veterinary (animal health) office.
samples.hyp: Bayan haka, sun yi amfani da hanyoyin ƙididdiga don ƙididdige yawan cutar kumburin zuciya a cikin dabbobi, da kuma yadda cutar ke tasowa a cikin yankuna daban-daban.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun ce kaska masu cutarwa sun yaɗu a wurin binciken, kuma adadin masu kamuwa da cutar kumburin zuciya yana ƙaruwa daga shekara guda zuwa gaba.
samples.ref: The researchers said the harmful ticks were widespread in the study area, and that the number of heartwater disease cases increased from one year to the next.
samples.hyp: Haka kuma, an gano cewa kaskun da ke cikin jini na iya haifar da kumburi a cikin jini, wanda ke haifar da haɓakar ƙwayoyin jini.  Wannan ya nuna cewa kaskun da ke cikin jini na iya zama babban abin damuwa a cikin haɓakar cutar.

samples.src: Sun tattara kaskoki guda 310 a tsakanin shekarar 2017 da kuma shekarar 2019.
samples.ref: They collected 310 ticks between 2017 and 2019.
samples.hyp: An gudanar da gwaje-gwaje a cikin dakin gwaje-gwaje mai tsabta, kuma an yi amfani da kayan aiki na zamani don tabbatar da ingancin sakamakon.

samples.src: Sun sami nau’o’in kaska guda 3: kaska ta Afirka ta Kudu, kaska mai lanƙwasasshiyar ƙafa, da kuma kaska launin kare mai ruwan ƙasa.
samples.ref: They found 3 types of ticks: the South African bont tick, the bont-legged tick, and the brown dog tick.
samples.hyp: An gano cewa kaskun Afirka ta Kudu ta fi yawa a cikin samfurin.

samples.src: Wadda ta fi zama gama-gari ita ce bont tick ta Afirka ta Kudu (85%), kuma wannan ita ce take ɗauke da ƙwayoyin cutar da suke haifar da cutar kumburin zuciya.
samples.ref: The most common was the South African bont tick (85%), and this is the one that carries the bacteria that causes heartwater disease.
samples.hyp: Ƙwayoyin cutar da ke cikin bont tick sun shiga jikin ɗan'adam ta hanyar kumburi a wurin da suka yi cika.  Baya ga kumburi, wasu mutane suna iya samun alamun rashin lafiya, kamar zubar da jini, ciwon ƙafa, da kumburin ƙwayayen jini.  A wasu lokuta, cutar na iya haifar da cutar kumburi a cikin jiki.

samples.src: Sauran nau’o’in kaska guda 2 da aka gano ba sa taimakawa ga cutar kumburin zuciya, amma suna da alaƙa da wasu cututtukan dabbobi kamar 'cutar cizon kaska mai sa zazzaɓi mai zafi da ƙarancin jini', 'cutar cizon kaska mai sa yawan zafin jiki da tsoka mai raɗaɗi ' da kuma 'cutar cizon kaska mai sa yawan zafin jiki da tari da kuma fitsari mai duhu '.
samples.ref: The other 2 types of tick they identified do not contribute to heartwater disease, but are linked to other livestock diseases like ‘theileriosis’, ‘anaplasmosis’ and ‘babesiosis’.
samples.hyp: Bugu da ƙari, an gano cewa kasan nau'in kaska yana da alaƙa da haɓaka haɗarin hawan jini a cikin mutane.

samples.src: Yankin da masu binciken suka yi nazari sun shafi Goodhope da Kanye da Moshupa da kuma Jwaneng.
samples.ref: The area that the researchers studied covered Goodhope, Kanye, Moshupa, and Jwaneng.
samples.hyp: An gudanar da gwaje-gwaje a cikin ɓangaren gona, inda aka riga aka shirya ƙwayoyin cuta, a cikin ƙananan jarrabobi.  An riga aka shirya ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin ruwan da aka nuna a kan lakabi, sannan an saka su a cikin ƙananan jarrabobi.  An saka ƙananan jarrabobi a cikin ƙananan ƙungiyoyi, kuma an rufe su da filastik.  An sanya ƙananan ƙungiyoyi a wajen da ba a dawo da su ba, kuma an bar su har zuwa lokacin da aka samu sakamakon da ake so.

samples.src: Ticks sun fi yawa a cikin Goodhope, Kanye da Moshupa.
samples.ref: Ticks were more abundant in Goodhope, Kanye and Moshupa.
samples.hyp: An gano cewa tsabar yawan ticks a cikin Goodhope shine 65%, a Kanye 58%, kuma a Moshupa 49%.

samples.src: Waɗannan wuraren galibi suna da laima, dutse kuma suna da ciyayi da yawa.
samples.ref: These areas were mostly moist, rocky and had more vegetation.
samples.hyp: Sake-sake da ƙwayoyin cuta, da kuma yawan mutane, suna da alaƙa da ƙarancin ƙwayoyin cuta masu amfani.  Ƙungiyar da ta fi yawa a cikin samfurin ita ce *Bacillus subtilis*, wacce ta kasance kashi 30% na dukkan ƙwayoyin cuta.  Sauran ƙwayoyin cuta sun haɗa da *Streptomyces spp.*, *Pseudomonas spp.*, da *Aspergillus spp.*.

samples.src: Jwaneng, wanda yake da mafi ƙarancin adadin kaska, ya kasance busasshen yashi kuma yana da ƙarancin ciyayi.
samples.ref: Jwaneng, which had the least number of ticks, was rather dry, sandy and had less vegetation.
samples.hyp: A cikin ƙwayar cuta, an gano cewa kaskatawa ta ƙwayar cuta ta ƙara yawan adadin furotin mai kauri, wanda ke taimaka wa ƙwayar cuta ta haɗu da sassan jikin ɗan'adam.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun ce bayanan dabbobi sun nuna adadin 42 na cututtukan kumburin zuciya a Goodhope, 38 a Jwaneng, 75 a Kanye, da kuma 146 a Moshupa, daga shekarar 2017 zuwa shekarar 2019.
samples.ref: The researchers said veterinary records revealed a total of 42 cases of heartwater in Goodhope, 38 in Jwaneng, 75 in Kanye, and 146 in Moshupa, from 2017 to 2019.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun ce cutar kumburin zuciya ta shafi akuyoyi da shanun gida fiye da irin na wasu ƙasashe.
samples.ref: The researchers said heartwater affected local goats and cattle breeds more than breeds from other countries.
samples.hyp: Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa akwai bambance-bambance tsakanin yawan cutar a cikin mutanen da ke zaune a cikin gari da na waɗanda ke zaune a ƙauye.  Haka kuma, an gano cewa yawan cutar ya fi yawa a cikin mata fiye da maza.  Masu bincike sun bayyana cewa cutar kumburi ta iya zama mai ƙarfi a cikin mutanen da ke zaune a cikin gari saboda yanayin rayuwarsu.

samples.src: Sun kuma ce manoma sun yi wani ƙoƙari na shawo kan kaska.
samples.ref: They said farmers made some efforts to control ticks.

samples.src: Alal misali, kashi 63% na manoma na tsoma dabbobin a cikin maganin kashe ƙwari (sinadaran da ake amfani da su don kashe ƙwari kamar kaska).
samples.ref: For example, 63% of farmers dipped the animals in pesticides (chemicals used to kill pests like ticks).

samples.src: Kusan kashi ɗaya bisa uku (30%) na manoman sun shafa man giris ga dabbobinsu don shawo kan kaska, yayin da wasu (7%) suka koma gina sababbin gidajen dabbobi.
samples.ref: About one third (30%) of the farmers applied grease to their animals to control the ticks, while others (7%) resorted to building new kraals.
samples.hyp: Kashi 23% na manoman sun yi amfani da hanyoyin biyayya, yayin da kashi 40% suka yi amfani da wasu hanyoyin da ba a bayyana ba.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa kashi 44% na manoma ba sa yin wani abu don tunkarar dabbar da ake zargi da rashin lafiya, yayin da kashi 15% suka ce za su ziyarci jami’an kula da dabbobi domin neman shawara, amma sun ba wa dabbobin magunguna da kansu.
samples.ref: The researchers also found that 44% of farmers did not do anything to deal with a suspected sick animal, while 15% said they would visit veterinary officers for advice, but gave medicine to the animals themselves.
samples.hyp: Kashi 12% kuma sun ce za su jira har sai lokacin da dabbobin za su sami damar samun magani a asibiti. Kashi 39% kuma sun ce ba su da wani shiri.

samples.src: Duk da cewa akwai maganin rigakafin kamuwa da cutar kumburin zuciya, masu binciken sun ce kashi 93% na manoma ba sa amfani da shi.
samples.ref: Even though there was a vaccine available to prevent heartwater disease, the researchers said 93% of the farmers did not use it.
samples.hyp: Haka kuma, kashi 87% na manoma sun ce ba su da isasshen ilimi game da cutar kumburin zuciya.

samples.src: Manoman sun shaida wa masu binciken cewa saboda ba a wayar musu da kai game da maganin rigakafin ba, kuma saboda ba za su iya sayen allurar rigakafin ba.
samples.ref: Farmers told the researchers that it was because they were not educated about the vaccine, and because they could not afford the vaccine.

samples.src: Sauran nazarin da aka yi a baya sun yi nazari a kan yadda ake rarraba kaska a Afirka, ciki har da ƙasar Botswana, amma a cewar masu binciken, nasu ne ya fara duba alaƙar da take tsakanin kaska da cutar kumburin zuciya a ƙasar Botswana.
samples.ref: Other studies in the past looked at how ticks were distributed in Africa, including Botswana, but according to the researchers, theirs was the first to look at the relationship between ticks and heartwater cases in Botswana.
samples.hyp: A cikin wani binciken da aka yi a cikin shekarar 2021, an gano cewa akwai bambanci mai yawa a tsakanin bambance-bambancen kaska a cikin mutanen Botswana, kuma wannan ya iya zama dalili na bambance-bance a cikin yadda cutar kumburin zuciya ke shafar mutane.

samples.src: Haka nan kuma sun ce lamarin cutar kumburin zuciya da likitocin dabbobi suke rubutawa na iya zama ƙasa da na ainihin cutar da manoma ke fuskanta, domin likitocin dabbobi kan yi gwajin cutar kumburin zuciya ne kawai idan dabba ta mutu, ma’ana ba ko yaushe ake ƙidaya dabbobin da suke ɗauke da cutar ko dabbobin da suka warke.
samples.ref: They said the cases of heartwater recorded by veterinary doctors might actually be less than the actual cases experienced by farmers, because veterinary doctors usually only test for heartwater disease when an animal has died, meaning that animals living with the disease or animals that recovered are not always counted.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa a ilimantar da manoma a kan yadda za su shawo kan cutar kumburin zuciya a dabbobinsu, ta yadda za a rage musu nauyin yawaitarsu a yankin.
samples.ref: The researchers recommended that farmers should be educated on how to control and manage heartwater disease in their livestock, so as to reduce its burden in the area.

samples.src: Haka nan sun kuma ce ya kamata a ƙara yin bincike domin gano abubuwan da suke haifar da bunƙasuwar kaska.
samples.ref: They also said more research should be done to determine factors that lead to the thriving of ticks.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun kasance a ƙasar Botswana.
samples.ref: The researchers were based in Botswana.
samples.hyp: Sun yi amfani da kayan aiki na gani don gano ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin samfurin ruwa. Sun gano ƙwayoyin cuta 15 daban-daban. Duk da haka, kawai ƴan adadi ne waɗanda suka wuce ƙimar da aka ƙayyade. Masu bincike sun yi amfani da hanyoyin da suka dace don ƙididdige adadin ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin kowane samfurin.

samples.src: Matsalolin Gwajin Wurin Kulawa a Indiya da kuma Afirka ta Kudu
samples.ref: Barriers to Point of Care Testing in India and South Africa
samples.hyp: sun haɗa da rashin isasshen kayan aiki, ƙarancin ma'aikata, da kuma ƙalubalen samun isasshen adadi na mazauna. A wasu lokuta, ƙalubalen samun isasshen adadi na mazauna na iya zama sakamakon ƙalubalen samun isasshen adadi na mazauna a cikin ƙungiyoyin da ake buƙata.

samples.src: Gwajin wurin kulawa (POC) a cikin al’ummomi, wuraren gida da cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya na farko an yi imanin suna da babban tasiri wajen rage jinkirin ganowa da fara jiyya ga cututtuka irin su cutar HIV da tarin fuka da ƙuraje da kuma zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
samples.ref: Point of care (POC) testing in communities, home settings, and primary healthcare centers is believed to have tremendous potential in reducing delays in diagnosing and initiating treatment for diseases such as HIV, tuberculosis, syphilis, and malaria.
samples.hyp: Wannan bincike ya yi nazari game da tasirin POC a cikin al'ummomin Najeriya.

samples.src: Bincika cuta mai sauri da ƙarin yanke shawara na gudanarwa da aka kammala a cikin haɗuwar asibiti ɗaya ko aƙalla rana guda, a yayin da majiyyaci yake jira, ya yi alƙawarin shawo kan jinkirin da yake tattare da gwajin tushen ɗakin gwaje-gwaje na yau da kullum.
samples.ref: Quick diagnosis and further management decisions completed in the same clinical encounter or at least the same day, while the patient waits, promise to overcome delays associated with conventional laboratory-based testing.
samples.hyp: A wannan yanayin, an ƙara ƙididdigar da aka samu daga gwaje-gwajen da aka yi a cikin haɗuwar asibiti, tare da ƙididdigar da aka samu daga gwajen da aka yi a cikin haɗuwar asibiti, don ƙirƙirar ƙididdigar da ta fi dacewa.

samples.src: Ko ta yaya, samuwar gwaje-gwaje masu arha da sauƙi da kuma sauri waɗanda za a iya gudanar da su a wajen ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje ba sa tabbatar da nasarar gwajin POC kai-tsaye.
samples.ref: However, the availability of cheap, simple, and rapid tests that can be conducted outside laboratories does not automatically ensure successful POC testing.

samples.src: Domin fahimtar sababbin ayyuka da ƙalubalolin na’urorin likitanci kamar irin waɗannan gamuwa, muna buƙatar yin nazarin yadda ake amfani da binciken lafiya a POC da haɗawa cikin ayyukan aiki da hanyoyin majiyyaci.
samples.ref: In order to understand the new roles and challenges medical devices such as these encounter, we need to study how diagnostics are used at the POC and integrated into workflow and patient pathways.

samples.ref: This chapter reviews selected results from a qualitative research project on barriers to POC testing in India and South Africa and discusses them comparatively.

samples.src: Aikin ya yi amfani da tambayoyin da aka fara tsara su da kuma tattaunawa ta rukuni domin nazarin ayyukan bincike a cikin manyan cututtuka da kuma masu taka muhimmiyar rawa a gidaje da dɗakunan shan magani da al’ummomi da asibitoci da kuma ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje a Afirka ta Kudu da kuma Indiya.
samples.ref: The project used semi-structured interviews and focus group discussions to examine diagnostic practices across major diseases and actors in homes, clinics, communities, hospitals, and laboratories in South Africa and India.
samples.hyp: An yi amfani da bayanan da aka samu don ƙirƙirar ƙa'idar ainihi na yadda ake gudanar da bincike a cikin waɗannan wurare.

samples.src: A wajen kwatanta zaɓaɓɓun sakamakon, ya bayyana a fili cewa ƙasashen biyu suna da tsarin yanayin bincike daban-daban waɗanda suke bayar da yanayi daban-daban domin gwajin POC.
samples.ref: In comparing selected results, it becomes clear that both countries have very different diagnostic eco-systems that provide very different conditions for POC testing.
samples.hyp: Tsarin yanayin da aka yi amfani da shi a cikin binciken da aka yi a kasar Sin ya ƙunshi ɗaukar samfurin jini daga masu jinya, da kuma gudanar da gwajin POC a cikin asibiti. A wajen binciken da aka yi a Najeriya, an ɗauki samfurin jini daga masu jinya a gida, kuma an gudanar da gwajin POC a cikin asibiti.

samples.src: Babin ya kammala ta hanyar yin tunani a kan yadda za a yi l’'akari da irin waɗannan bayanan a yayin zayyana shirye-shiryen gwajin POC.
samples.ref: The chapter concludes by reflecting on how to take such insights into account when designing POC testing programs.
samples.hyp: Domin haka, ya zama dole a yi la'akari da matakan da za a ɗauka don tabbatar da ingancin bayanan da aka samu, da kuma yadda za a adana su, da kuma yadda za a rarraba su. Haka kuma, ya zama dole a yi la'akari da yadda za a yi amfani da bayanan don inganta ingancin aikin likita.

samples.src: Ƙarancin gwajin kulawa a Afirka ta Kudu da Indiya yana jinkirta kiwon lafiya
samples.ref: Poor point-of-care testing in South Africa and India delays healthcare
samples.hyp: da ci gaba. Ƙididdigar da aka gudanar a cikin shekarar 2021 ta nuna cewa kashi 25% na yara a Afirka ta Kudu da kashi 30% na yara a Indiya ba su da damar samun kulawar da suke buƙata. Wannan rashin kulawa na iya zama mai illa ga lafiyar yara, tunda yana iya haifar da rashin ci gaba, cuta, da kuma mutuwar yara.

samples.src: Wurin Kulawa (POC) yana nufin gwaje-gwajen kiwon lafiya da ake yi a wuri guda inda majiyyaci yake samun kulawa, maimakon aika samfuran marasa lafiya zuwa ɗakin gwaje-gwaje domin gwaji.
samples.ref: Point-of-care (POC) refers to healthcare tests that are done in the same place where the patient receives care, rather than sending patient samples away to a laboratory for testing.
samples.hyp: A cikin wannan binciken, mun yi amfani da abun da ake kira "samfurin ƙididdiga" don ƙididdige yawan cutar da aka samu a cikin ƙungiyoyin da aka bincaka.

samples.src: Afirka ta Kudu da Indiya ba sa isar da gwaji mai sauri da kuma inganci saboda tsarinsu na POC da kuma ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje.
samples.ref: South Africa and India don’t deliver fast and efficient testing because of their poor POC systems and labs.

samples.src: Gwajin POC yana ba marasa lafiya damar samun damar yin gwajin sauri tare da sakamako mai sauri don magani da kuma magance cututtuka.
samples.ref: POC testing allows patients to have access to fast testing with quick results for the treatment and management of diseases.
samples.hyp: Yayin da gwaje-gwaje na POC ke ƙara yawa, yana da mahimmanci a lura da ingancin gwaje-gwaje da kuma ƙa'idodi don tabbatar da sakamakon gwaje-gwaje.

samples.src: Ana iya yin wannan tare da injuna masu arha da sauƙi waɗanda za su iya bayar da sakamakon gwaji cikin sauri ba tare da ɗaukar samfurorin zuwa ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje ba.
samples.ref: This can be done with relatively cheap and simple machines that can give test results quickly without having to take the samples to labs.

samples.src: Amma akwai ƙalubaloli da yawa a cikin POC da suke rage jinkirin kula da majiyyata a Afirka ta Kudu da kuma Indiya.
samples.ref: But there are many challenges in POC that slow down patient care in South Africa and India.
samples.hyp: Waɗannan ƙalubalun sun haɗa da ƙarancin kayan aiki, ƙarancin ƙwararrun ma'aikata, da kuma ƙalubalen da suka shafi daidaito da kuma amsoshi. Hakanan, ƙalubalun da suka shafi daidaito da kuma amsoshi na iya haifar da bambance-bambance a cikin sakamakon gwaje-gwaje, wanda ke haifar da ƙalubalun a cikin tafarkin gudanar da bincike.

samples.src: Mawallafan sun so su kwatanta gwajin POC a Afirka ta Kudu da kuma Indiya domin su iya gano matsalolin.
samples.ref: The authors wanted to compare POC testing in South Africa and India so that they could identify problems.

samples.src: Sun gudanar da tambayoyi da tarurruka na rukuni tare da ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya da majiyyata da kamfanonin na’urorin kiwon lafiya daga watan Satumba na shekarar 2012, zuwa watan Yuni na shekarar 2013, a cikin ƙasashen biyu.
samples.ref: They held interviews and group meetings with healthcare workers, patients and medical device companies from September, 2012, to June, 2013, in both countries.

samples.src: Sun yi tambaya game da hanyoyi da mtsalaolin POC.
samples.ref: They asked about POC processes and problems.
samples.hyp: An gano cewa, a cikin ƙungiyar, akwai bambance-bambance tsakanin yawan adadin ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin jini da kuma a cikin ƙwayar cuta, kuma wannan bambance-bambance ya ƙara da yawan adadin ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin jini.  Wannan ya nuna cewa, a cikin ƙungiyar, ƙwayoyin cuta na iya ƙara yawan adadin su a cikin jini, kuma wannan ya iya zama dalili na kamuwa da cuta.

samples.src: A cikin lafiyar jama'a, Indiya tana amfani da ƙananan ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje da yawa kuma suna yin gwaje-gwaje na yau da kullum, amma ba a ba wa ɗakunan gwaje-gwajensu isasshen kuɗi, don haka ba su da isassun kayan da za su yi gwajin.
samples.ref: In public healthcare, India uses multiple small labs and do basic tests, but their labs are not given enough money, so they don’t have enough materials to do the testing.

samples.src: Sau da yawa ana gaya wa marasa lafiya su dawo wata rana ko kuma su tafi wani wuri, wanda hakan yake haifar da matsala ga marasa lafiya.
samples.ref: Patients are often told to come back on another day or to go somewhere else, which causes problems for the patients.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun kuma lura cewa a wasu lokuta ana gwada marasa lafiya amma sai a ɗauki lokaci mai tsawo kafin sakamakon ya dawo, kuma suna samun wahalar tuntuɓar likitansu bayan haka.
samples.ref: The researchers also noticed that sometimes patients are tested but it takes long for the results to come back, and they find it hard to get in touch with their doctor afterwards.
samples.hyp: Wannan yana iya haifar da damuwa da kuma ƙalubale a cikin tsarin kula da lafiya.

samples.src: Masu shiga binciken sun ce ya kamata a ƙara yawan ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje a asibitoci, kuma ana iya yin gwajin a daidai wurin da marasa lafiya suke shiga.
samples.ref: The participants said that there should be more labs in hospitals, and that testing could be done at the same place where patients enter.
samples.hyp: Haka kuma, sun bayyana cewa, idan an ƙara yawan ƙungiyoyin da ke gudanar da gwajai, za a iya ƙara yawan mutanen da za a gwada, kuma za a iya samun sakamakon bincike daidai.

samples.src: Har ila yau, sun ce ya kamata a yi bibiyar da jiyya ko bayar da shawara a wuri guda.
samples.ref: They also said that follow-ups, treatments or counselling should also happen at the same place.

samples.src: A ƙasar Afirka ta Kudu, sun gano cewa a cikin lafiyar jama'a, kamfani 1 ne yake gudanar da duk gwajin, don haka samfurorin suna zuwa ga wannan kamfani.
samples.ref: In South Africa, they found that in public healthcare, 1 company handles all the testing, so the samples go to this company.
samples.hyp: A wasu ƙasashe, akwai kamfanonin da suke gudanar da gwajin, kuma samfurin yana zuwa ga dukkanin kamfanoni. A cikin bincikenmu, mun yi amfani da samfurin da aka samu daga Afirka ta Kudu.

samples.src: Ana yin wasu ƙananan gwaje-gwaje a wurin kulawa, kuma marasa lafiya suna samun sakamakon da sauri.
samples.ref: Some basic tests are done at the point of care, and the patients do get the results quickly.

samples.src: Gwaje-gwajen cutar HIV da kuma TB suna ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo don haka, ana jinkirin bibiyar ko jiyya.
samples.ref: HIV and TB tests take longer and so follow-ups or treatments are also delayed.
samples.hyp: Hakan na iya haifar da mummunan tasiri ga lafiyar mutane.

samples.src: Sauran jinkirin su ne saboda sufuri, kuskuren rubuta sunayen marasa lafiya, ɓata sunan samfururori da kuma rushewar na’urar kwamfuta.
samples.ref: Other delays are because of transport, incorrect spelling of patients’ names, mislabelling of samples, and the breakdown of computer systems.
samples.hyp: Haka kuma, an gano cewa wasu daga cikin samfurorin da aka ajiye a cikin kasa sun lalace.

samples.src: Domin gwajin cutar HIV, wasu ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje suna yin amfani da hanyoyi daban-daban na gwaji, kuma wannan yana bayar da sakamako marar inganci.
samples.ref: For HIV testing, some labs used different methods of testing, and this gives unreliable results.
samples.hyp: Saboda haka, ya zama dole a haɗa hanyoyin gwaji daidai da ƙa'idodi masu ƙayatarwa.

samples.src: Sun gano cewa marasa lafiya suna ƙoƙarin yin gwajin cutar HIV bisa la’akari da nisan wurin ko kuma nau'in gwajin, kuma saboda haka wasu lokuta suna amfani da katin shaida na daban, wanda yake haifar da matsala a yayin da ake ƙoƙarin samun bibiyar baya.
samples.ref: They found that patients try to get HIV testing based on the distance to the site or the type of test, and because of this they sometimes use a different identity card, which causes problems when trying to get follow-up meetings.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa dole ne ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya su yi aiki tare don raba nauyin aikin.

samples.ref: Researchers thus proposed that critical care could be defined as all the care that patients with critical illness got right from the time they visit healthcare workers for a consultation to the time they die or recover.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun ce wannan shi ne bincike na farko da ya tattara bayanai a kan ma’anoni daban-daban na rashin lafiya mai tsanani da kuma kulawa, kuma sakamakonsu zai taimaka wajen inganta kula da mutanen da suke fama da rashin lafiya sosai.
samples.ref: The researchers said this was the first study that gathered information on different definitions of critical illness and care, and that their results would help improve the care of people who are very ill.

samples.src: Sai dai sun ce binciken nasu yana iya iyakancewa da cewa ba su yi amfani da ma'anar wasu harsuna fiye da Ingilishi ko kuma daga tushen da ba a buga ba.
samples.ref: They however said their study might be limited by the fact that they did not use definitions from other languages beyond English or from unpublished sources.

samples.src: Masu binciken, waɗanda suka fito daga jami'o'i a Malawi da Tanzaniya da Sweden da kuma Burtaniya, sun ce za a iya ƙara gyara ma’anonin da suka gabatar idan an buƙata.

samples.src: Allo mai faxin genom na CRISPR-Cas9 yana gano CENPJ a zaman mai kula da daidaiton qwayar halitta da aka canza yayin kamuwa da cutar hanta na qwayar cutar zazzavin cizon sauro
samples.ref: A genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 screen identifies CENPJ as a host regulator of altered microtubule organization during Plasmodium liver infection
samples.hyp: (Dengue virus). A cikin samfurin da aka yi, an gano cewa CENPJ yana da alaƙa da ƙarancin yawan ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin jini, wanda ke nuna cewa yana da matuƙar muhimmanci a cikin tsarin yawan ƙwayoyin cuta.

samples.src: Kafin fara cutar zazzavin cizon sauro, fulasmodum sufurozote guda ɗaya yana cutar da sel na hanta mai suna hefatosit kuma yana haɓaka zuwa dubunnan merozotai a wani ɓangare ta hanyar ɓarnata albarkatun abin da cutar ta kama.
samples.ref: Prior to initiating symptomatic malaria, a single Plasmodium sporozoite infects a hepatocyte and develops into thousands of merozoites, in part by scavenging host resources.
samples.hyp: A matsayin sakamakon wannan ɓarna, sel ɗin yana ƙara yawan ƙwayar jini, wanda ke haifar da ƙwayar jini mai yawa a cikin jini. Haka kuma, cutar tana haifar da haɓakar sel na jini mai ƙarfi, wanda ke haifar da ƙwayar jini mai ƙarfi a cikin jini.

samples.src: Mun nuna cewa rundunonin makurotubs suna sake tsarawa a hankali a kusa da matakan hanta masu tasowa (LS).

samples.hyp: Mun kuma gano cewa ƙwayoyin da ke cikin ƙwayar cuta sun ƙara yawan gurbatar da su a cikin ƙwayar cuta a matakan hanta masu tasowa.

samples.src: Ta hanyar amfani da allon CRISPR-Cas9 mai faɗi, mun gano masu daidait matattarar sitoskeleton, fataucin besikul, matsewar ER/Golgi da hanyar bayogenesis na lipid wanda ke daidaita ci gaban fulasmodum.
samples.ref: Using a genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 screen, we identified host regulators of cytoskeleton organization, vesicle trafficking, ER/Golgi stress and lipid biogenesis that regulate Plasmodium LS development.

samples.src: Waɗannan sabbin masu kula da kamuwa da cuta, gami da protin J (CENPJ), sun sa mun yi tambayoyi game da yadda ake sarrafa cibiyoyin tsara makurotub (MTOCs) yayin kamuwa da cuta.
samples.ref: These novel regulators of infection, including Centromere Protein J (CENPJ), led us to interrogate how microtubule organizing centers (MTOCs) are regulated during infection.
samples.hyp: Mun gano cewa, a cikin ƙwayoyin ɗan'adam, protin J (CENPJ) yana da alaƙa da ƙarancin adadin ƙwayoyin ɓangare da ke da alaƙa da MTOCs. Wannan ya nuna cewa protin J (CENPJ) na iya zama mai mahimmanci wajen daidaita adadin ƙwayoyin ɓangare da ke da alaƙa da MTOCs a lokacin kamuwa da cuta.

samples.src: Fosin γ-tubulin wanda aka keɓance shi zuwa gaɓoɓin qwayar cuta; ragewar CENPJ ya tsananta wannan ƙara kamuwa da cuta.
samples.ref: Foci of γ-tubulin localized to the parasite periphery; depletion of CENPJ exacerbated this re-localization and increased infection.

samples.src: Bugu da qari, mun nuna cewa Golgi yana aiki a matsayin MTOC maras-tsakiya ta hanyar shirya γ-tubulin da haɓaka ƙwayar cuta ta makrotub a gefen qwayar cutar.
samples.ref: Further, we show that the Golgi acts as a non-centrosomal MTOC by organizing γ-tubulin and stimulating microtubule nucleation at the parasite periphery.
samples.hyp: Hakanan, mun gano cewa ƙwayar cutar ta makrotub ta haɗu da ƙwayar cutar ta Golgi, wanda ke haɓaka haɓaka ƙwayar cutar.

samples.src: Gabaɗaya, mun nuna cewa fulasmodum LS na ɗaukar Golgi na abin da cutar ya kama don samar da hanyoyin sadarwa na MT waɗanda ake ɗaukar ababe zuwa PVM, don tallafawa haɓaka matakin hanta.
samples.ref: Collectively, we show that the Plasmodium LS recruits the host Golgi to form MT mediated conduits along which host organelles are recruited to the PVM, to support liver stage development.

samples.src: Abubuwan da muka gano sun nuna yawancin magunguna da suke kama qwayar da cuta ta kama na iya hana kamuwa da LS.

samples.src: Masana kimiyya suna nazarin yadda cutar zazzavin cizon sauro ke fasa qwayar halitta don qoqarin faɗaɗa zaɓuɓɓukan magani

samples.src: Yawancin ƙwayoyin cuta suna amfani da sinadirai da albarkatun sel na ɗan adam ko dabba da suka shiga don haifuwa da kansu.
samples.ref: Many parasites use the nutrients and resources of their human or animal host’s cells to reproduce themselves.

A cikin wannan bincike, mun yi amfani da sinadirai da albarkatun sel na ɗan adam don haifuwa da ƙwayoyin cuta. Mun kuma yi amfani da wasu ƙwayoyin cuta don taimakawa wajen haifuwa.

samples.src: A cikin wannan binciken, masu bincike sun gano takamaiman qwayoyin halittar da ke taka rawa wajen kamuwa da cutar zazzavin cizon sauro a cikin qwayoyin hanta, wanda zai iya haifar da sabbin dabarun yaqi da zazzavin cizon sauro nan gaba.
samples.ref: In this study researchers identified specific genes that play a role in malaria infections in liver cells, which could lead to new anti-malaria drug targets in future.

samples.src: Zazzavin cizon sauro cuta ce mai yaxuwa kuma mai kisa ta hanyar kwayar cutar da ake kira da Plasmodium, wacce ake yaxa ta ta hanyar cizon sauro.
samples.ref: Malaria is a wide-spread and potentially life-threatening disease caused by the Plasmodium parasite, which is transmitted via mosquito bites.
samples.hyp: Cutar na iya haifar da matsaloli masu yawa, kamar wahala a numfashi, zubar da jini, da kuma mutuwa. Yawan yawan cutar ya bambanta daga wuri zuwa wuri, amma a wasu sassan duniya, cutar na iya kashe kashi 20% na yara da suke da shekaru 5 zuwa 15.

samples.src: Bayan shiga cikin jiki, qwayar cutar zazzavin na tafiya ne kai tsaye zuwa hanta don ya hayaiyafa - wannan matakin farko ya dace da maganin zazzavin cizon sauro saboda babu alamun cutar tukuna kuma cutar ba za a iya yaxa ta ba.
samples.ref: Upon entry into the body, Plasmodium heads straight for the liver to reproduce - this early stage is ideal for antimalarial treatment because there are no disease symptoms yet and the disease can’t be transmitted.
samples.hyp: A matsayin sakamako, maganin zazzabin cizon sauro ba zai iya yaxa cutar ba.

samples.ref: In this study, researchers wanted to find specific changes to genes and proteins in infected liver cells that can change how an infection develops.

samples.ref: Using the gene-editing technology CRISPR-Cas9, the researchers were able to deactivate or “knockout” specific genes to see what changes when those genes are inactive.

samples.src: Waxannan sifofi masu kama da bututu suna shiga, a tsakanin sauran abubuwa, motsin abubuwan gina jiki da kayan cikin sel, kuma yawanci suna samar da hanyar sadarwa a kusa da qwayar tantanin halitta.
samples.ref: These tube-like structures are involved in, among other things, the movement of nutrients and materials inside cells, and they usually form a network around the cell nucleus.

samples.ref: One of the key findings is that Plasmodium hijacks the microtubules in liver cells - instead of the microtubules clustering around the nucleus delivering nutrients and materials to where the cell needs it, the microtubules cluster around the parasite delivering nutrients and materials to help the parasite reproduce.

Translation:
Female genital mutilation (FGM), the practice of altering or injuring the female genitalia, continues to occur illegally or in secret in countries such as Kenya, Ethiopia, and Indonesia. FGM can cause a number of health problems, including infection, bleeding, and chronic pain. It also has a devastating impact on women's health and well-being. Organizations and authorities that oppose FGM have worked to end this practice, but it continues to occur.

samples.src: Wasu kuma (24%) sun kasance kayan aikin gini da yin kayan aikin lambu da sarƙar rufin rufi da kuma yin igiya.
samples.ref: Others (24%) served as materials for building, making garden tools, roof thatching and making ropes.
samples.hyp: Wasu (12%) sun kasance aikin gona, yayin da wasu (10%) sun kasance aikin gona.

samples.src: Tun da yawancin mazauna karkara an ba da rahoton suna yin amfani da itacen wuta, an yi amfani da kashi 25% na tsirrai don haka.
samples.ref: Since the majority of the rural populations reportedly used firewood, 25% of plants were used for that.
samples.hyp: An gano cewa wannan yawanin ya fi yawa a cikin mazauna da ke zaune a yankin arewa maso gabas.  Babban dalili na amfani da itacen wuta a wannan yanki shine sauƙin samun shi, da kuma farfajiyar sa.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun ce shuka guda ɗaya (0.4%) ce aka ambata don dalilai masu guba.
samples.ref: The researchers said only one (0.4%) plant was mentioned for poisoning purposes.
samples.hyp: A cikin ƙungiyar da aka bincaka, an gano cewa mutane 12 sun sami ƙwayar cutar, kuma daga cikinsu, 6 ne suka nuna alamun cuta.  A cikin mutanen da suka sami ƙwayar cutar, ƴan yawa sun ba da labarun cewa sun ji zafi, sun yi ta ƙanƙanta, da kuma gajiya.

samples.src: Har ila yau, sun ce yadda ake rarraba tsirrai a yankin ya shafi muhalli, abin da mutane suke so su ci, da kuma halin kuɗi na iyali da kuma buƙatun kasuwanci.
samples.ref: They also said the way plants were distributed in the area was influenced by the environment, what people liked to eat, as well as family financial status and business needs.
samples.hyp: Ƙoƙarin da aka yi don inganta noman shanu a yankin ya haɗa da samar da irin ganye-ganye da ke da ƙarfi, da kuma samar da hanyoyin da za su taimaka wa manoma wajen sarrafa ƙa'ida.

samples.src: Misali, wani yanki da ake kira Wenka wanda yake da magudanar ban ruwa kuma yana kusa da babban gari, yana da lambuna da yawa kuma yana da tsirrai daban-daban har guda 130.
samples.ref: For example, an area called Wenka that had irrigation water and was close to a main town, had many gardens and recorded 130 different plants.

samples.src: Mutanen Wenka kuma suna shuka da kuma ssamar da kayan marmari da kuma kayan lambu ga kasuwar garin.
samples.ref: The Wenka people also grew and supplied fruits and vegetables to the town market.
samples.hyp: Sakamakon, an gano cewa mutanen Wenka suna da abinci mai gina jiki sosai, kuma suna da lafiya.  A gefe guda, mutanen garin sun fi amfani da kayan abinci da aka haɓaka, waɗanda keɓancewar su na abinci ya sa su fi lalacewa.

samples.src: Daga ƙarshe, masu binciken sun ce yawancin manoma sun fi son shuka tsirrai masu amfani da yawa.
samples.ref: Lastly, the researchers said most farmers preferred to grow plants that had many uses.
samples.hyp: Saboda haka, an gudanar da bincike don tantance abubuwan da suka fi amfani ga manoman, da kuma yadda za a inganta samar da abinci. A ƙarshe, an gano cewa manoman sun fi amfani da irin tsirrai da ke ba da kaxin da ake bukata, da kuma waɗanda ke da ƙarancin buƙatu.

samples.src: Masu binciken sun ce sakamakon nasu ya tabbatar da cewa, haƙiƙa manoma suna shuka nau’o’in tsirrai da yawa a cikin lambunansu, da kuma amfani daban-daban.
samples.ref: The researchers said their results confirmed that indeed farmers grew a high number of different types of plants in their gardens, and for different uses.
samples.hyp: Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa, akwai bambance-bambancen muhimmi a cikin nau’o’in tsirrai da manoma ke shuka, da kuma yadda suke amfani da su, a yankuna daban-daban.  Wannan ya nuna cewa, akwai buƙata don bincake yadda manoma ke amfani da nau’o’in tsirrai daban-daban a yankuna daban-daban, domin samun ƙarin fahimta game da aikin gona a Afirka.

samples.src: Ko da yake waɗannan masu binciken sun gano cewa yawancin manoma suna shuka ganyayyaki, wasu masu binciken sun ce bishiyoyi sun fi yawa a yankin.
samples.ref: Even though these researchers found that most farmers grew herbs, others researchers had said trees were more common in the area.

samples.src: Masu binciken wannan binciken sun kasance ne daga jami'o'i a ƙasar Habasha.
samples.ref: The researchers of this study were based in universities in Ethiopia.
samples.hyp: Sun yi amfani da bayanan da aka samu daga asibitai da kuma cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya da ke cikin birnin Addis Ababa, babban birnin ƙasar. Bayanai sun ƙunshi bayanan mutane da aka yi wa gwajin cutar kwayar cuta, da kuma bayanan da suka samo asali daga gwaje-gwaje na asibiti. Masu bincike sun yi amfani da hanyoyin ƙididdiga don ƙididdige yawan mutanen da suka kamu da cutar, da kuma yadda cutar ke tasowa a cikin birnin.
